## 2. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) end to end

This section follows the 26D Procure-to-Pay cycle step by step. Each step has the same compact table: purpose, roles, where it lives in the UI, tables, statuses, REST roots, bulk and scheduled processes, and the controls that usually cause exceptions. Table names, primary keys, column names and column comments come from the 26D Tables and Views guides. UI paths, roles and process behaviour come from the 26D Using and Implementing guides, the security references and the 26D readiness notes. Anything not confirmed there is marked "(verify in your pod)". Full REST paths are in section 6. FBDI templates and scheduled-process parameters are in section 7. Subledger accounting internals are in section 4. The Payables Agent and Payments Agent are in section 10.

### P2P flow at a glance

| Step | Business event | Primary document and table | Accounting impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2.1 Supplier onboarding | Registration approved; supplier, address, site, site assignment, contact and bank account created | Supplier: POZ_SUPPLIERS, POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M, POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M; party HZ_PARTIES; payee IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL | None. The site assignment holds the default liability and prepayment accounts and the distribution set |
| 2.2 Requisitioning | Requisition submitted and approved | POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL, POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL | No GL journal. With Budgetary Control, funds are reserved at submission or at approval. Encumbrance accounting is created only when the requisition is implemented |
| 2.3 Sourcing and agreements (optional) | Negotiation awarded; blanket or contract agreement approved | PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL, PON_BID_HEADERS; agreement in PO_HEADERS_ALL (TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE BLANKET or CONTRACT) | None |
| 2.4 Purchase orders | PO approved, communicated, acknowledged; change orders processed | PO_HEADERS_ALL, PO_LINES_ALL, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL | None, unless Budgetary Control or encumbrance is used (FUNDS_STATUS at every level) |
| 2.5 Receiving | Receive, inspect, deliver or put away, correct, return; ASN | RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS, RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES, RCV_TRANSACTIONS | Accrue at receipt: Receipt Accounting records the accrual when the item is received (CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS). Accrue at period end: uninvoiced receipt accrual at period end, reversed in the next period by Create Accrual Reversal Accounting |
| 2.6 Invoice capture | Invoice entered, imported, scanned or submitted by the supplier | AP_INVOICES_ALL, AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL | None until the invoice is validated and accounted |
| 2.7 Matching, validation, holds, approval | Invoice matched and validated; holds applied or released; invoice approved | AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL, AP_HOLDS_ALL | Event Invoice Validated. For accrue-at-receipt POs the receipt accrual is reversed and the liability is recorded. Price and conversion-rate variances go to variance accounts |
| 2.8 Prepayments, memos, withholding | Prepayment applied; credit or debit memo validated; withholding calculated | AP_INVOICES_ALL (invoice type), AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL (prepayment and withholding lines), ZX_WITHHOLDING_LINES | Events Prepayment Applied or Unapplied, Credit Memo Validated, Debit Memo Validated; withholding invoice to the tax authority |
| 2.9 Payments | Payment process request completed; quick, manual or refund payment; void or stop | AP_CHECKS_ALL, AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL, IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL, IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL | Event Payment Created. "At payment issue": debit liability, credit cash. "At payment issue and clearing": credit cash clearing. "At payment clearing": nothing until clearing |
| 2.10 Accounting | Create Accounting run; journals transferred and posted | XLA_EVENTS, XLA_AE_HEADERS, XLA_AE_LINES; GL_JE_HEADERS, GL_JE_LINES | Subledger journals in the ledger |
| 2.11 Bank reconciliation | Statement line reconciled; payment cleared | CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS, CE_STATEMENT_LINES, CE_RECON_HISTORY_ITEMS; AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL | Event Payment Cleared. "At payment clearing": debit liability, credit cash. "At payment issue and clearing": debit cash clearing, credit cash |
| 2.12 Period close | Payables period closed; receipt accruals booked; reconciliations signed off; GL period closed | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES, CMR_PERIOD_STATUSES, CMR_ACCRUAL_SUMMARY | Uninvoiced receipt accruals; unaccounted transactions swept to the next period |

The accounting column follows the Payables variance-account rules, the payment accounting option and the uninvoiced receipt accrual process ([Variance Accounts](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/variance-accounts.html), [Guidelines for Payment Accounting Options](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/faipp/guidelines-for-payment-accounting-options.html), [Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/supply-chain-and-manufacturing/26d/faspc/create-uninvoiced-receipt-accrual.html)). Oracle says not to change the payment accounting option after the first implementation.

### 2.1 Supplier onboarding and maintenance

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Maintain the supplier master: organization party, supplier profile, addresses, sites, site assignments, contacts and payment data (payee, payment methods, bank accounts). A site represents the relationship between one procurement BU and the supplier. A site assignment lets a client BU transact with the site and defines its bill-to BU. Registration requests (business relationship Prospective or Spend Authorized) are approved before a supplier record is created. |
| Typical job roles | Supplier Administrator (Abstract Role): maintains suppliers, approves profile changes, registers new suppliers. Supplier Manager (Abstract Role): controls the addition of new suppliers and spend authorization. Procurement Application Administrator (Job Role): registration setup. Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role) includes the Payee Bank Account Management duty. Supplier users: Supplier Self Service Administrator and Supplier Self Service Clerk (Abstract Roles); Supplier Accounts Receivable Specialist (Job Role) can request bank-account and payment-method changes. |
| Where in the UI | Suppliers work area (Overview page for Supplier Administrator and Supplier Manager) > Create Supplier task > Edit Supplier page with tabs Profile, Addresses, Sites (subtab Site Assignments, action Autocreate Assignments) and Contacts. Bank accounts: Edit Supplier > Profile > Payments > Bank Accounts subtab; the same subtab exists on Edit Address and Edit Site. Registration: external registration URL (encrypted business relationship and inviting procurement BU, one-time email access code); internal registration from Self Service Procurement or the Suppliers work area; category managers from Sourcing. Supplier Portal: Redwood home page `https://<POD_HOST>/fscmUI/redwood/supplier-portal/home?fscmui_app_context=redwood_supplier_portal`; the Company Profile card is Redwood after opt-in. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | POZ_SUPPLIERS (VENDOR_ID); POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M (VENDOR_SITE_ID); POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M (ASSIGNMENT_ID); POZ_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS (VENDOR_CONTACT_ID); POZ_SUPPLIER_REGISTRATIONS (SUPPLIER_REG_ID); POZ_SUPP_REQUESTS (SUPP_REQUEST_ID, profile change requests); POZ_SUPPLIERS_PII (VENDOR_ID, VPD-secured tax identifiers); HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID); HZ_PARTY_SITES (PARTY_SITE_ID); IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL (EXT_PAYEE_ID); IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS (EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID); IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS (ACCOUNT_OWNER_ID); IBY_PMT_INSTR_USES_ALL (INSTRUMENT_PAYMENT_USE_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | POZ_SUPPLIER_REGISTRATIONS.REGISTRATION_STATUS: DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELED. POZ_SUPPLIERS.CREATION_SOURCE: MANUAL, IMPORT, REGISTRATION, INTERNAL_REGISTRATION; BUSINESS_RELATIONSHIP; START_DATE_ACTIVE and END_DATE_ACTIVE. Site: INACTIVE_DATE and purpose flags PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG, PAY_SITE_FLAG, RFQ_ONLY_SITE_FLAG, PRIMARY_PAY_SITE_FLAG. Assignment: INACTIVE_DATE. POZ_SPEND_AUTH_REQUESTS.REQUEST_STATUS: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELED. |
| REST root resources | suppliers (children Addresses, Sites, Sites/Site Assignments, Sites/Third-Party Payment Relationships, Contacts, Business Classifications, Products and Services, Spend Authorization Requests); supplierRegistrationQuestionnaireResponses, supplierRegistrationConfigurations, supplierRegistrationOptions and the supplierRegistration... LOV resources (banks, bank branches, certifying agencies, products and services, roles); supplierOptions; externalBankAccounts; paymentsExternalPayees |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Procurement FBDI, each with a scheduled process of the same name: Import Suppliers, Import Supplier Addresses, Import Supplier Sites, Import Supplier Site Assignments, Import Supplier Contacts, Import Supplier Business Classifications, Import Supplier Products and Services Categories, Import Supplier Attachments. Also Inactivate Suppliers. Payments FBDI: Supplier Bank Account Import (SupplierBankAccountImportTemplate.xlsm, interface tables IBY_TEMP_EXT_PAYEES, IBY_TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCTS, IBY_TEMP_PMT_INSTR_USES), run through Load Interface File for Import and then Import Supplier Bank Accounts. Supplier import rejections are in POZ_SUPPLIER_INT_REJECTIONS. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Registration review checks company name, D-U-N-S number and tax identifiers against the supplier master to prevent duplicates. Approvers can edit a registration, but not its bank accounts. Every site needs an active site assignment before POs or invoices can use it. Site-level P2P controls: TOLERANCE_ID and SERVICES_TOLERANCE_ID (invoice tolerance templates), MATCH_OPTION, PAY_ON_CODE (pay on receipt), CREATE_DEBIT_MEMO_FLAG, HOLD_ALL_PAYMENTS_FLAG, HOLD_UNMATCHED_INVOICES_FLAG, INVOICE_AMOUNT_LIMIT, TERMS_ID, PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE. Assignment-level defaults: ACCTS_PAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID, PREPAY_CODE_COMBINATION_ID, DISTRIBUTION_SET_ID, AWT_GROUP_ID. Supplier-initiated bank changes arrive as change requests (POZ_SUPP_BANK_ACCT_REQUESTS) that need approval. |

### 2.2 Requisitioning

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Capture internal demand from catalogs (agreement-based local catalog items, punchout), noncatalog requests (goods and fixed price services; rate-based services are a separate variant), smart forms (preconfigured forms with defaults, extended by information templates) and shopping lists. The requisition is routed for approval, funds are reserved if Budgetary Control is enabled, and approved lines go either to a buyer or to automated order creation. |
| Typical job roles | Procurement Requester (Abstract Role); Advanced Procurement Requester (Abstract Role); Procurement Preparer (Abstract Role); Procurement Catalog Administrator (Abstract Role) for catalogs, smart forms and information templates. Approvers come from the approval rules. |
| Where in the UI | Navigator > Procurement > Purchase Requisitions (New), also on the springboard; this is the Self Service Procurement application (URL path `/fscmUI/redwood/procurement/requisitions`). On the Requisitions page, search or browse Featured categories > Add to Cart > Cart (navigation bar or View Cart) > Submit. On the same page: Create Noncatalog Request (Noncatalog Request page), or select a smart form > Create Request (Create Request page). The Home page shows My recent requisitions. The requisition life cycle view shows Requisition Lines, Negotiations, Orders, Shipments, Receipts and Invoices. Approval rules: Setup and Maintenance > Approval Management functional area > Manage Requisition Approvals. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL (REQUISITION_HEADER_ID); POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL (REQUISITION_LINE_ID); POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (DISTRIBUTION_ID); POR_REQ_INFO_TEMPLATE_VALUES (INFO_TEMPLATE_VALUES_ID); POR_ONE_TIME_LOCATIONS (ONE_TIME_LOCATION_ID); interface tables POR_REQ_HEADERS_INTERFACE_ALL, POR_REQ_LINES_INTERFACE_ALL, POR_REQ_DISTS_INTERFACE_ALL |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | Header DOCUMENT_STATUS and line LINE_STATUS (values in 2.14); header LIFECYCLE_STATUS (rolled up) and line LIFECYCLE_STATUS; FUNDS_STATUS on header, line and distribution. Line ITEM_SOURCE: catalog, noncatalog, quick create, punchout, req import or service. Header PROCESS_STATUS during import: POST_PLSQL, then COMPLETED. |
| REST root resources | purchaseRequisitions (actions include submitRequisition, checkFunds, withdraw, cancel, returnLines, reassignBuyer, splitLine, getApprovalWorkflowStatus, retrieveCurrentApprovers); requisitionLifecycleDetails; recentRequisitions; shoppingSearches; shoppingCatalogs; smartForms; shoppingCatalogSmartFormDetails; localCatalogs; punchoutCatalogs; publicShoppingLists; personalShoppingLists; requisitionPreferences |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Import Requisitions. Scheduled processes: Import Requisitions; Update Preparer and Requester; Generate Orders (parameters Procurement BU, required; Requisitioning BU; Requisition), which moves approved requisitions into the procurement BU, creates orders for lines set up for touchless buying and sends the other lines to the buyer's queue ([Generate Orders](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/faspp/generate-orders.html)) |
| Key controls and exceptions | Requisition approval stages run in sequence: Header Preapproval Stage, Header Stage, Header Postapproval Stage, Postapproval FYI Stage. Participants route in serial, in parallel (consensus or first responder wins) or as FYI. List builders: Supervisory, Position, Job Level, Single User, User-Defined Routing, Approval Groups ([Considerations for Setting Up Requisition Approval Task](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oapro/considerations-for-setting-up-requisition-approval-task.html)). On the requisition header, FUNDS_CHK_FAIL_WARN_FLAG is Y when the implicit funds check at submission returns failures or warnings, and INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_FLAG is Y when it fails and an override is requested. A funds override needs the Request Budgetary Control Override privilege, override enabled on the control budget, remaining override limit and an identifiable override approver. Rejecting a requisition releases its reserved funds. Emergency requisitions reserve a PO number (EMERGENCY_REQ_FLAG, EMERGENCY_PO_NUMBER). Punchout lines that exceed the catalog price tolerance set PRICE_VARIANCE_EXCEEDED_FLAG. BUYER_PROCESSING_FLAG locks a line while a buyer processes it. |

### 2.3 Sourcing and agreements (optional)

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Negotiate with suppliers and award to a standard PO, a blanket purchase agreement or a contract purchase agreement, or author agreements directly. The three negotiation types are auction (response: bid), RFI (response) and RFQ (quote). Agreements supply the prices and terms that requisition sourcing and automated ordering use. |
| Typical job roles | Category Manager (Job Role) creates negotiations; Sourcing Project Collaborator (Abstract Role); Buyer (Job Role) and Procurement Manager (Job Role) for agreements; Procurement Contract Administrator (Job Role) for contract terms. Supplier side: Supplier Sales Representative (Job Role) creates and submits negotiation responses, acknowledges agreements and proposes changes; Supplier Bidder (Abstract Role) is a prospective supplier's sales representative who responds to RFQs, RFPs, RFIs and reverse auctions (duties Negotiation Response Creation as Supplier and Negotiation Response Management as Supplier). |
| Where in the UI | Negotiations work area (Ongoing Negotiations, Recent Activity). Requisition demand can be added to a negotiation from Process Requisitions (document builder). After an award, purchasing documents are created on the Create Purchase Documents page. Purchase Agreements work area: agreement infolets, including Consumption at Risk. Supplier Portal: Negotiations (Redwood) and Agreements (Redwood after opt-in) cards. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | PON_AUCTION_HEADERS_ALL (AUCTION_HEADER_ID); PON_AUCTION_ITEM_PRICES_ALL (AUCTION_HEADER_ID, LINE_NUMBER); PON_BID_HEADERS (BID_NUMBER); PON_BID_ITEM_PRICES (BID_NUMBER, LINE_NUMBER, AUCTION_LINE_NUMBER); PON_BACKING_REQUISITIONS (AUCTION_HEADER_ID, LINE_NUMBER, REQUISITION_LINE_ID); PON_AWARD_ALLOCATIONS (ORIG_REQ_LINE_ID, BID_LINE_NUMBER, BID_NUMBER). Agreements: PO_HEADERS_ALL (PO_HEADER_ID), PO_LINES_ALL (PO_LINE_ID), price breaks in PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL (LINE_LOCATION_ID). |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | PO_HEADERS_ALL.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE BLANKET or CONTRACT; DOCUMENT_STATUS; START_DATE and END_DATE (validity); BLANKET_TOTAL_AMOUNT; AMOUNT_RELEASED (sum of approved standard PO amounts against the agreement). Requisition-line sourcing markers: AT_SOURCING_FLAG, ON_RFQ_FLAG, AUCTION_HEADER_ID, BID_NUMBER, NEGOTIATION_REQUIRED_FLAG. Negotiation status codes: negotiationStatusesLOV. |
| REST root resources | supplierNegotiations; supplierNegotiationResponses; draftSupplierNegotiationResponses; supplierNegotiationAwards; supplierNegotiationPurchasingDocuments (CreatePurchasingDocuments, SubmitPurchasingDocuments); purchaseAgreements; draftPurchaseAgreements; purchaseAgreementLines; purchaseAgreementImportRequests; purchaseAgreementAcknowledgments |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Blanket Purchase Agreements Import with process Import Blanket Agreements; FBDI Contract Purchase Agreements Import with process Import Contract Agreements; Import Negotiation Lines. Sourcing processes: Create Purchasing Documents, Submit Purchasing Documents. Purchasing processes: Initiate Retroactive Price Update, Recalculate Released Amount on Purchasing Agreements. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Negotiation and award approvals. A requisition sourced to a contract agreement converts automatically only when Negotiated is selected on the line. Agreement control actions: Cancel and Finally Close stop new releases; Freeze blocks edits but allows releases; Hold blocks releases. Required acknowledgment levels: Document, or Document and Line for blanket agreements. Retroactive pricing is controlled by the agreement options. |

### 2.4 Purchase orders

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Turn approved demand into supplier commitments. Paths: buyer processing of requisition lines, automated order creation (touchless buying), online entry, or import. Then approval, communication, supplier acknowledgment, change orders and closure. |
| Typical job roles | Buyer (Job Role); Procurement Manager (Job Role); approvers from the purchasing approval rules. Supplier side: Supplier Sales Representative (Job Role) with Acknowledge Purchase Order and Change Purchase Order privileges. |
| Where in the UI | Purchase Orders work area (the Purchase Agreements work area has the same task): Process Requisitions task, where you search requisition lines, add them to the document builder and choose document type, style and line grouping. Manage Orders task to search orders, for example status Pending Supplier Acknowledgment. Order Actions: Edit or Cancel (either creates a change order), Close, Finally Close, Freeze, Hold, communicate. Infolets include Orders Requiring Attention. Supplier side: Supplier Portal work area, or the Redwood Orders card after opt-in, to accept, partially accept, reject or propose changes. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | PO_HEADERS_ALL (PO_HEADER_ID); PO_LINES_ALL (PO_LINE_ID); PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL (LINE_LOCATION_ID, the schedule); PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID); PO_VERSIONS (VERSION_ID); PO_ACTION_HISTORY (OBJECT_ID, OBJECT_TYPE_CODE, OBJECT_SUB_TYPE_CODE, SEQUENCE_NUM, ACTION_CODE); PO_HEADERS_ARCHIVE_ALL (PO_HEADER_ID, FROM_CO_SEQ) and the other archive tables; interface tables PO_HEADERS_INTERFACE, PO_LINES_INTERFACE, PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_INTERFACE, PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_INTERFACE |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | PO_HEADERS_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS (full list in 2.14); APPROVED_FLAG (Y = approved), CANCEL_FLAG, FROZEN_FLAG, REVISION_NUM, ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED_FLAG, ACCEPTANCE_DUE_DATE, SUPPLIER_NOTIF_METHOD, DOCUMENT_CREATION_METHOD. PO_LINES_ALL.LINE_STATUS. PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.SCHEDULE_STATUS, CLOSED_FOR_RECEIVING_DATE, CLOSED_FOR_INVOICE_DATE, SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE. PO_VERSIONS.CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS and CO_SEQUENCE (change order number, starting at 0). |
| REST root resources | purchaseOrders (actions acknowledge, cancel, close, communicate, hold, removeHold, freeze, unfreeze, reopen, submit, viewPDF); draftPurchaseOrders (drafts and change orders; actions submit, checkFunds, withdraw, cancelChangeOrder, calculateTaxAndAccounting); purchaseOrderSchedules (close, confirmWork); purchaseOrderAcknowledgments; purchasingDocumentChanges; purchasingDocumentHistoryDetails; requisitionProcessingRequests (processRequest); purchaseOrderLifeCycleDetails; purchasingDocumentImportErrors |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Purchase Orders Import with process Import Orders. Import Orders Approval Action: Do Not Approve (Incomplete), Submit for Approval, or Bypass Approval (Open; needs a privilege). Also Generate Orders, Communicate Purchasing Document (print, email or fax; document selection New, Changed, New and Changed or Specified), Reassign Purchasing Document, Purge Processed Open Interface Documents. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Approval runs through Approval Management, with predefined stages Preapproval, Terms, Post Approval and Post Approval FYI. Funds are checked and reserved when Budgetary Control is enabled. Required acknowledgment: Document, or Document and Schedule for standard POs. A change order keeps the approved version as the source of truth until it is approved, accepted and validated. Closure tolerances on the schedule: RECEIVE_CLOSE_TOLERANCE, INVOICE_CLOSE_TOLERANCE and the receipt close point. Matching controls on the schedule: MATCH_OPTION (invoice matched to PO or receipt), RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG and INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG (match level, see 2.7), ACCRUE_ON_RECEIPT_FLAG. Control-action effects: Close drops supply, recreated on reopen; Hold blocks receiving and invoicing but not returns; Finally Close blocks receiving, returns and invoicing. |

### 2.5 Receiving

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Record receipt of goods and services against PO schedules or ASNs, inspection (accept or reject), delivery or put away to the destination, returns to supplier and corrections. Suppliers send ASNs and ASBNs. Receipt Accounting creates accruals for accrue-at-receipt schedules. |
| Typical job roles | Receiving Agent (Job Role): receive, inspect, returns. Warehouse Operator (Job Role): put away. Receiving Specialist (Job Role). Requesters, preparers and on-behalf users manage self-service receipts. Cost Accountant (Job Role): receipt accounting. Suppliers create ASNs in the Supplier Portal. |
| Where in the UI | Navigator > Supply Chain Execution > Inventory Management work area. Receipts infolets drill into Receive Expected Shipments, Inspect Receipts, Put Away Receipts and Manage All Lines. Create Receipt and Add to Receipt pages, then Receive Lines. Review Receipts Interface task. Self-service: My Receipts in the Procurement work area (Receive Items and Manage Receipts pages), or the responsive My Receipts (New) > Orders to Receive, which needs the Receiving Self-Service Responsive Application User Duty. Supplier Portal: Advance Shipment Notices (Redwood) and Receipts and Returns (Redwood) cards. Receipt Accounting work area: Review Receipt Accounting Distributions. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS (SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID); RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES (SHIPMENT_LINE_ID); RCV_TRANSACTIONS (TRANSACTION_ID); RCV_SUPPLY (SUPPLY_TYPE_CODE, SUPPLY_SOURCE_ID); RCV_RECEIPT_DELIVERIES (RECEIPT_DELIVERY_ID); RCV_PARAMETERS (ORGANIZATION_ID); interface tables RCV_HEADERS_INTERFACE, RCV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE, RCV_INTERFACE_ERRORS. Receipt accounting: CMR_I_RCV_TRANSACTIONS; CMR_RCV_TRANSACTIONS (CMR_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID); CMR_RCV_EVENTS (ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID); CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS (CMR_SUB_LEDGER_ID); CMR_ACCRUAL_SUMMARY (CMR_PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS.RECEIPT_SOURCE_CODE: VENDOR, INVENTORY, TRANSFER ORDER, CUSTOMER, OUTSOURCER; ASN_TYPE: ASN, ASBN, STD. RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES.SHIPMENT_LINE_STATUS_CODE: EXPECTED, PARTIALLY RECEIVED, FULLY RECEIVED, CANCELLED. ROUTING_HEADER_ID: 1 Standard receipt, 2 Inspection required, 3 Direct delivery. RCV_TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTION_TYPE (see 2.14), INSPECTION_STATUS_CODE (NOT INSPECTED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED), ACCRUAL_STATUS_CODE (PENDING, INTERFACED, ERROR). CMR_RCV_EVENTS.ACCOUNTED_FLAG: N, D (draft), F (final). |
| REST root resources | receivingReceiptRequests (receipts and ASNs); receivingReceiptTransactionRequests (inspect, put away, correct, return); receivingReturns; receivingTransactionsHistory; linesToReceive; purchaseOrdersForReceiving; asnsForReceiving; receivingReceiptDeliveries; receiptAdviceLines; invoiceMatchingReceiptQuantityTransactions |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Receiving Receipt Import (ReceivingReceiptImportTemplate.xlsm, which loads the receiving and inventory interface tables) with process Manage Receiving Transactions. Also Confirm Receipts; Send Pay on Receipt; Transfer Transactions from Receiving to Costing (hourly or several times a day; one instance at a time); Create Receipt Accounting Distributions. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Tolerances on the schedule and in receiving parameters: QTY_RCV_TOLERANCE with QTY_RCV_EXCEPTION_CODE (REJECT, WARNING, NONE); DAYS_EARLY_RECEIPT_ALLOWED and DAYS_LATE_RECEIPT_ALLOWED with RECEIPT_DAYS_EXCEPTION_CODE; ENFORCE_SHIP_TO_LOCATION_CODE; ALLOW_SUBSTITUTE_RECEIPTS_FLAG. Routing can be overridden at receipt when the receiving profile allows it. Rows in RCV_TRANSACTIONS are never updated: corrections are new rows, and net quantities live in RCV_SUPPLY. Direct-delivery receipts are entered at distribution level; standard and inspection receipts at schedule level. The site flag CREATE_DEBIT_MEMO_FLAG ("whether a debit memo should be created") governs debit memos from returns to supplier (verify in your pod). Pay on receipt (site PAY_ON_CODE) creates unapproved standard invoices, numbered with the ERS- prefix by default. |

### 2.6 Supplier invoice capture

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Record supplier invoices (standard, credit memo, debit memo, prepayment and the other types in 2.14). Channels: manual entry, spreadsheet, integrated imaging (designated email inbox with intelligent data recognition), electronic invoices, Supplier Portal, pay on receipt, FBDI and REST. AI-driven capture with the Payables Agent is covered in section 10. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Specialist (Job Role): enters and matches invoices. Accounts Payable Supervisor and Accounts Payable Invoice Supervisor (Job Roles). Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role). Supplier side: Supplier Accounts Receivable Specialist (Job Role), with the Self Service Payables Invoice Entry duty. |
| Where in the UI | Payables icon > Invoices icon > Invoices landing page (infotiles Scanned, Recent, Holds, Approvals, Prepayments, Payments). Create Invoice and Edit Invoice pages; Manage Invoices page; Create Invoice in Spreadsheet task; Correct Import Errors task. Image invoices with exceptions are marked incomplete, routed by a BPEL workflow and shown in the Scanned infotile. Supplier Portal: classic Create Invoice and Create Invoice without PO, or the 26D Redwood Invoices and Payments card. That card needs the site-level profile options ORA_AP_INVOICES_PAYMENTS_SUPPLIER_PORTAL_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_AP_SUPPLIER_PORTAL_ELASTIC_SEARCH_ENABLED and ORA_FND_SEARCH_EXT_ENABLED set to Yes, and it replaces the classic entry points. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | AP_INVOICES_ALL (INVOICE_ID); AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL (INVOICE_ID, LINE_NUMBER); AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID); AP_BATCHES_ALL; AP_INVOICE_RELATIONSHIPS (RELATED_INVOICE_ID, ORIGINAL_INVOICE_ID); interface tables AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE (INVOICE_ID, LOAD_REQUEST_ID), AP_INVOICE_LINES_INTERFACE (INVOICE_LINE_ID), AP_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS (PARENT_TABLE, PARENT_ID, LOAD_REQUEST_ID, REJECT_LOOKUP_CODE) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE (lookup type INVOICE TYPE); SOURCE (lookup type SOURCE: Spreadsheet, External or user-defined; maintained with the Manage Payables Lookups task); ROUTING_STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE (invoice routing in process or complete); AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE.STATUS (documented values NEW, NULL); AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL.LINE_SOURCE and LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE (Item, Freight, Miscellaneous, Tax, Prepayment, Withholding Tax lines). REST defaults: ValidationStatus Not Validated, PaidStatus Unpaid, AccountingStatus Unaccounted. |
| REST root resources | invoices (actions validateInvoice, calculateTax, generateDistributions, cancelInvoice, cancelLine, applyPrepayments, unapplyPrepayments, reverseDistributions); payablesInterfaceInvoices (submitImportInvoices, interfaceRejections, interfaceLineRejections); payablesInvoicesInSupplierPortal (calculateTax, submitInvoice, cancelInvoice); erpintegrations (FBDI upload and import, section 7) |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Payables Standard Invoice Import (PayablesStandardInvoiceImportTemplate.xlsm). Run Load Interface File for Import with import process Import Payables Invoices, then Import Payables Invoices with Source External (or Spreadsheet). Also Payables Payment Request Import, and Send Pay on Receipt for receipt-based invoices. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Invoice number must be unique for the supplier site (interface column comment). Document sequencing: the voucher number is in DOC_SEQUENCE_VALUE. Image routing: incomplete invoices go to users with the View Scanned Payables Invoice privilege; fixing them needs Edit or Create Payables Invoice. A saved Supplier Portal invoice has status Incomplete (Pending Import after submission); it is visible in Manage Invoices, but Payables can't edit or cancel it until the supplier submits it, and saved invoices block the Payables period close until swept. Approval can be skipped for invoices imported from a specific source with a standard lookup whose code equals the Source value; this doesn't work for manually created or REST-created invoices ([Exclude Approval for Invoices Imported from a Specific Source](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/exclude-approval-for-invoices-imported-from-a-specific-source.html)). Import errors are fixed in the Correct Import Errors spreadsheet; some tax errors (for example a tax-only line without account information) appear only in the import log. |

### 2.7 Matching, validation, holds and approval

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Match invoice lines to PO schedules or distributions, receipts or consumption advice; validate; resolve holds; approve. Validation generates distributions (defaults, distribution sets, charge allocations), calculates tax and withholding, checks variances between ordered, received, consumed and invoiced quantities or amounts, applies or releases holds, and checks project data, conversion rates and period status. With Budgetary Control it also reserves funds. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Specialist (Job Role) matches and validates. Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role) gets Release Hold on Payables Invoice and Initiate Payables Invoice Approval Task Flow through the Payables Invoice Processing duty, and Force Approve Payables Invoice through the Payables Period Close duty. Accounts Payable Supervisor and Accounts Payable Invoice Supervisor (Job Roles) also hold Release Hold on Payables Invoice through the Payables Invoice Processing duty; neither is granted Force Approve Payables Invoice. Invoice approvers: by default the requester's supervisor approves invoices of 1000 or more, and invoices under 1000 are approved automatically. Buyers and receivers are involved through the holds resolution workflow. |
| Where in the UI | Create or Edit Invoice: Match Invoice Lines (to PO, receipt or consumption advice), Validate action, Manage Holds action. Manage Invoices page: Release Holds action. Holds and Approvals infotiles on the Invoices landing page. Approval actions on Edit Invoice and Manage Invoices: Initiate, Withdraw, Hold, Force Approve, Resubmit; approvers respond from email, Worklist, the Invoices landing page or Edit Invoice. Setup: Manage Invoice Options (Enable invoice approval, Require validation before approval, Accounting Preference, Allow force approval, Allow final matching); Manage Invoice Holds and Releases page; invoice tolerance templates; Manage Task Configuration for Financials for approval routing. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL (match columns PO_HEADER_ID, PO_LINE_ID, PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID, PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID, RCV_TRANSACTION_ID, RCV_SHIPMENT_LINE_ID); AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID); AP_HOLDS_ALL (HOLD_ID); AP_HOLD_CODES (HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE); AP_TOLERANCE_TEMPLATES (TOLERANCE_ID); billed quantities in PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL and RCV_TRANSACTIONS (QUANTITY_BILLED, AMOUNT_BILLED) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | Validation status (UI and REST ValidationStatus) is derived; the 26D Tables and Views guide documents no validation-status column on AP_INVOICES_ALL. Related columns: FORCE_REVALIDATION_FLAG ("Indicator to enable revalidation of the invoice"), VALIDATION_REQUEST_ID, and unreleased AP_HOLDS_ALL rows. The 26D comment on AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.MATCH_STATUS_FLAG says only that it indicates whether the distribution is generated for a PO-matched line, so don't treat it as a validation flag without checking (verify in your pod). AP_INVOICES_ALL.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS and APPROVAL_READY_FLAG; line WFAPPROVAL_STATUS; AP_HOLDS_ALL.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE, RELEASE_LOOKUP_CODE, STATUS_FLAG, WF_STATUS (holds resolution workflow). Value lists are in 2.14. |
| REST root resources | invoices (validateInvoice); invoiceHolds (place a hold with POST, release with PATCH); payablesInvoiceHolds (hold definitions, GET); invoiceApprovalsAndNotificationsHistory; payablesInvoiceTolerances |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Validate Payables Invoices: parameter Option = All (every invoice that isn't Validated, including invoices with unreleased holds) or New (only distributions entered or imported since the last validation); for recurring schedules, AutoIncrement advances the date parameters ([How Invoices Are Validated](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/how-invoices-are-validated.html)). Initiate Invoice Approval Workflow (schedule it to run regularly instead of initiating approval invoice by invoice). With integrated imaging, Oracle recommends scheduling Import Payables Invoices and Validate Payables Invoices every 15 to 30 minutes. Only the batch Validate Payables Invoices process places the system holds Tax Calculation and Tax Distribution Generation; online and REST validation don't show them |
| Key controls and exceptions | Match approval level: 2-way means PO and invoice quantities match within tolerance; 3-way adds receipt; 4-way adds accepted inspection quantities. On the schedule this follows RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG and INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG; the invoice match option (PO or receipt, MATCH_OPTION) is a separate setting. Tolerance templates (Ordered Percentage, Maximum Ordered, Received Percentage, Maximum Received, Price Percentage, Conversion Rate Amount, Schedule Amount, Total Amount, Consumed Percentage, Maximum Consumed) are assigned to the supplier site (site columns TOLERANCE_ID and SERVICES_TOLERANCE_ID). Amount-based templates use only Ordered Percentage, Maximum Ordered, Received Percentage, Maximum Received, Conversion Rate Amount and Total Amount. Manage Invoice Options holds the default Quantity tolerances and Amount tolerances sets. A zero percentage allows no variance; an active tolerance with no value allows unlimited variance. Holds that can be released manually include Qty Ord, Qty Rec, Price, Amount, Matching Required, Insufficient Funds and Tax Variance. Holds that can't include Dist Variance, Dist Acct Invalid, Final Matching and Funds Check ([Types of Holds](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/types-of-holds.html)). AP_HOLD_CODES.POSTABLE_FLAG controls whether a hold blocks accounting; USER_RELEASEABLE_FLAG controls manual release. Matching to receipts avoids holds on partial shipments, and Oracle calls it critical when periodic costing is used. |

### 2.8 Prepayments, credit and debit memos, withholding

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Prepayments: temporary when Allow prepayment application is enabled, permanent (for example a lease deposit) when it isn't. A prepayment application can be inclusive (Included on Invoice) or exclusive. Corrections: a price decrease, quantity correction or negative amount correction uses a credit or debit memo; a price increase or positive amount correction uses a standard invoice. Withholding is calculated at invoice validation or at payment, depending on the calculation point. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Specialist and Accounts Payable Supervisor (Job Roles) for prepayments and memos. Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role) holds Manage Payables Withholding Tax Groups and Manage Payables Withholding Tax Certificate; Accounts Payable Supervisor can submit the withholding reports |
| Where in the UI | Create Invoice with type Prepayment; prepayment apply and unapply on the invoice. Price, quantity and amount corrections on the invoice. Manage Tax Reporting and Withholding Tax Options (Allow manual withholding). Withholding groups sit on the supplier and the site assignment (ALLOW_AWT_FLAG, AWT_GROUP_ID). |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | AP_INVOICES_ALL (INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE); AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL (PREPAY_INVOICE_ID, PREPAY_LINE_NUMBER, CORRECTED_INV_ID); AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (PREPAY_DISTRIBUTION_ID, AWT_GROUP_ID); AP_PREPAY_HISTORY_ALL (PREPAY_HISTORY_ID); AP_PREPAY_APP_DISTS (PREPAY_APP_DIST_ID); AP_AWT_GROUPS (GROUP_ID); AP_AWT_TAX_RATES_ALL; ZX_WITHHOLDING_LINES (TAX_LINE_ID); AP_INVOICE_RELATIONSHIPS |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | A prepayment shows Unpaid until it is fully paid, even when partly paid; only a fully paid prepayment can be applied to a standard invoice or expense report ([FAQ](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/why-did-the-status-of-a-prepayment-invoice-be-displayed-as.html)). Distribution LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE (lookup type INVOICE DISTRIBUTION TYPE); invoice line types include Prepayment and Withholding Tax |
| REST root resources | invoices (applyPrepayments, unapplyPrepayments; children Applied Prepayments, Available Prepayments); withholdingTaxLines; withholdingTaxGroupsLOV |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Withholding tax reports in Payables (Payables Withholding Tax Report, Payables Withholding Tax by Tax Authority Report, Payables Withholding Tax Letter) |
| Key controls and exceptions | Applying a prepayment matched to a PO updates PO quantities. A payment for an applied prepayment can't be voided until the prepayment is unapplied. With the Invoice calculation point, withholding is calculated once; changes after validation need manual adjustment with Allow manual withholding. Applying a prepayment before validation withholds net of the prepayment. |

### 2.9 Payments

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Select installments; Oracle Payments then builds documents payable into payments and payments into payment files (payment instructions); validates, formats, transmits or prints, and confirms. Also quick payments (single payment without a payment process request), manual payments (made outside Payables and recorded), refunds (negative payment that closes a credit balance), void, stop and reissue, remittance advice and positive pay. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Payment Supervisor (Job Role); Payment Specialist (Job Role); Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role, with Disbursement Process Management and Payables Payment Processing duties); Cash Manager (Job Role) creates payment documents on internal bank accounts |
| Where in the UI | Payables icon > Payments > Overview page > Tasks > Submit Payment Process Request: invoice group or selection criteria, disbursement bank account, payment document, payment process profile; options Review installments, Review proposed payments, Create payment files immediately. Requiring Attention tab: review installments or proposed payments, then Resume Payment Process; Assign Payment Process Attributes page. Print Payment Documents; Payment File page > Record Print Status; Manage Payment Process Requests; Manage Payments page to void individual payments. Setup: Manage Payment Process Profiles; Manage Bank Accounts (payment documents); Manage Payment Options. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | AP_INV_SELECTION_CRITERIA_ALL (CHECKRUN_ID); AP_SELECTED_INVOICES_ALL (CHECKRUN_NAME, INVOICE_ID, PAYMENT_NUM); AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL (INVOICE_ID, PAYMENT_NUM); IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS (PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID); IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL (DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_ID); IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL (PAYMENT_ID); IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL (PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID); AP_CHECKS_ALL (CHECK_ID); AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL (INVOICE_PAYMENT_ID); AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL (PAYMENT_HISTORY_ID); CE_BANK_ACCT_USES_ALL (BANK_ACCT_USE_ID); CE_PAYMENT_DOCUMENTS (PAYMENT_DOCUMENT_ID); setup IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_B, IBY_ACCT_PMT_PROFILES_B, IBY_FORMATS_B |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS; IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS; IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS; IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_STATUS; PROCESS_TYPE (STANDARD, IMMEDIATE, MANUAL); AP_CHECKS_ALL.STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE, PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG, VOID_DATE, STOPPED_DATE, RELEASED_DATE; AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG and HOLD_FLAG. Values are in 2.14. |
| REST root resources | paymentProcessRequests (view and act, GET and PATCH); payablesPayments (create manual payments, void; actions initiateStopPayment, initiateEscheat; child Related Invoices); disbursementPaymentMethodsLOV; paymentProcessProfilesLOV; payeeBankAccountsLOV; cashBankAccounts |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Submitting the Submit Payment Process Request task (or a template from the Create Payment Process Request Template page) runs the Initiate Payment Process Request process together with the Payables Selected Installments Report ([Check Payments](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/faipp/set-up-and-make-check-payments.html)); Format Payment Files; Create Positive Pay File; Update Matured Bills Payable Status (Issued to Negotiable when bills payable mature); Apply Missing Conversion Rates. Reports: Payment File Register, Separate Remittance Advice, Payment Process Request Status. |
| Key controls and exceptions | When payment approval is enabled the request stops at Review Proposed Payments. Validations attached to the payment method or format run at document, payment and payment-file level; failures can stop the request or remove documents. Disbursement bank accounts and payment process profiles are assigned automatically when possible, otherwise on the Assign Payment Process Attributes page. Supplier site HOLD_ALL_PAYMENTS_FLAG and installment holds block selection. Print status must be recorded unless the profile records it automatically. Void is allowed for Negotiable, Issued and Stop initiated payments; reissue only for Quick payments in Negotiable status, and never for bills payable or electronic payment methods. A payment for an applied prepayment can't be voided or stopped until the prepayment is unapplied ([Payment Actions, Types, and Statuses](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/payment-actions-types-and-statuses.html)). With a cash budget for payments, payments reserve funds; voids carry a budget date, and reservation failures are reviewed in the View Funds Status dialog box. |

### 2.10 Accounting (Payables and Receipt Accounting; transfer to General Ledger)

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Create subledger journals for Payables events (event classes Invoices, Credit Memos, Debit Memos, Prepayments, Prepayment Applications, Payments, Reconciled Payments, Refunds, Bills Payable) and for Receipt Accounting events (receipt accruals, deliveries and put aways, landed cost, interorganization receipts, AP transactions for receipts, period-end accruals). Then transfer the journals to General Ledger and post them. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role, Subledger Accounting Manager duty) for Payables; Cost Accountant (Job Role) for Receipt Accounting; General Accountant (Job Role) for GL posting and review |
| Where in the UI | Scheduled Processes > Create Accounting. Parameters: Subledger Application (Payables or Receipt Accounting), Ledger, Process Category, End Date, Accounting Mode (Draft or Final), Process Events (All, Errors, Invalid Accounts), Report Style (Summary, Detail, No report), Transfer to General Ledger (default Yes), Post in General Ledger (default Yes, needs the posting privilege), Journal Batch. Online accounting from the transaction is handled by the Online Accounting Engine (the Subledger Accounting guide names the actions Account in Draft and Post to Ledger; exact Payables menu labels: verify in your pod). Receipt Accounting work area > Create Receipt Accounting Distributions, then Review Receipt Accounting Distributions (Distributions and Journal Entries tabs). Scheduled Processes: Transfer Costs to Cost Management (invoice cost details for PO-matched invoices) and Transfer Transactions from Receiving to Costing. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | Sources: AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL (ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID, POSTED_FLAG, BC_EVENT_ID), AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL (ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID, POSTED_FLAG), AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL (POSTED_FLAG), CMR_RCV_EVENTS (ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID), CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS (CMR_SUB_LEDGER_ID), CMR_AP_INVOICE_DTLS (EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE, EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID). SLA and GL: XLA_TRANSACTION_ENTITIES (ENTITY_ID), XLA_EVENTS (EVENT_ID, APPLICATION_ID), XLA_AE_HEADERS (AE_HEADER_ID, APPLICATION_ID), XLA_AE_LINES (AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, APPLICATION_ID), XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS, GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES, GL_JE_BATCHES (JE_BATCH_ID), GL_JE_HEADERS (JE_HEADER_ID), GL_JE_LINES (JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | POSTED_FLAG Y (accounted) or N; CMR_RCV_EVENTS.ACCOUNTED_FLAG N, D, F; XLA_EVENTS.EVENT_STATUS_CODE, PROCESS_STATUS_CODE, ON_HOLD_FLAG (Y or N); XLA_AE_HEADERS.ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE, GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE (code meanings in section 4); REST AccountingStatus (default Unaccounted) |
| REST root resources | erpintegrations (submit Create Accounting and the costing processes as scheduled jobs; section 7); journalBatches; subledgerApplicationsLOV; accountingEventClassesLOV; accountingEventTypesLOV; accountingPeriodsLOV |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Create Accounting; Post Subledger Journal Entries; Create Receipt Accounting Distributions; Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual; Create Accrual Reversal Accounting; Transfer Costs to Cost Management; Transfer Transactions from Receiving to Costing; Create Mass Additions (asset lines) |
| Key controls and exceptions | The Accounting Preference in Manage Invoice Options ties approval to accounting: account regardless of approval, require accounting before approval, or require approval before accounting. Holds can block accounting. Accrue at receipt: expense or inventory accrual account on the invoice distribution, quantity variance to the accrual account, invoice price variance and conversion rate variance to their own accounts. Accrue at period end (expense items): distribution and all variances go to the PO charge account. Multiperiod accounting is not supported on lines matched to accrue-at-receipt POs. Transfer Costs to Cost Management moves item costs, invoice price variances, nonrecoverable taxes and corrections of PO-matched invoices, but not freight, miscellaneous charges or recoverable taxes. |

### 2.11 Bank reconciliation of disbursements (Cash Management)

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Load bank statements, reconcile disbursements automatically or manually, and clear the matching payments. If payment accounting includes clearing, the Payment Cleared event is accounted. Bank errors, charges and exceptions are handled here too. |
| Typical job roles | Cash Manager (Job Role) |
| Where in the UI | Bank Statements and Reconciliation work area: submit the Autoreconciliation process; review reconciled and unreconciled lines; manual reconciliation (one to one, one to many, many to one, many to many; up to 10,000 system transactions on the page); Mark Reviewed. Setup: Bank Statement Reconciliation Matching Rules, Bank Statement Reconciliation Tolerance Rules, Bank Statement Automatic Reconciliation Matching Rule Set (assigned to the bank account), Bank Statement Transaction Creation Rules, parse rule sets. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS (STATEMENT_HEADER_ID); CE_STATEMENT_LINES (STATEMENT_LINE_ID); CE_RECON_HISTORY (RECON_HISTORY_ID); CE_RECON_HISTORY_ITEMS (RECON_HISTORY_ITEM_ID; RECON_SOURCE and SOURCE_ID identify the statement line or payables transaction); CE_RECON_EXCEPTIONS; CE_EXTERNAL_TRANSACTIONS; CE_STMT_IMPORT_ERRORS; CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS (BANK_ACCOUNT_ID); AP_CHECKS_ALL (CLEARED_DATE, CLEARED_AMOUNT, RECON_FLAG); AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS.RECON_STATUS_CODE (New, Ready, In Process, Complete, Reviewed) and AUTOREC_PROCESS_CODE (UNPROCESSED, INPROCESS, WARNING, ERROR, PROCESSED); CE_STATEMENT_LINES.RECON_STATUS, EXCEPTION_FLAG, FLOW_INDICATOR (CRDT, DBIT); AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL.TRANSACTION_TYPE (PAYMENT MATURITY, PAYMENT CLEARING, PAYMENT UNCLEARING) and MATCHED_FLAG; AP_CHECKS_ALL.RECON_FLAG (Y on clearing, N on unclearing); the payment shows status Cleared once it is reconciled |
| REST root resources | cashBankAccounts; cashExternalTransactions; cashBankAccountTransfers. The 26D REST lists contain no bank-statement root resource. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Cash Management Bank Statement Data Import; Cash Management Bank Statement Reconciliation Data Import; Cash Management External Transactions Import. Load and Import Bank Statement (formats BAI2, SWIFT MT940, EDIFACT FINSTA, ISO 20022 camt.052 and camt.053). Autoreconciliation. Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation Report. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Matching and tolerance rules are ordered inside the rule set; tolerance rules warn on or block breaches. Bank errors are corrected with the reversal method (error line, reversal line and correction entry all reconciled to the check) or the adjustment method. When payments are accounted at clearing, reconcile before closing the Payables period. Mark Reviewed prevents accidental unreconciliation. |

### 2.12 Period close for P2P

| Aspect | Details |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Finish P2P transactions, account and transfer them, sweep what can't be accounted, close the Payables period, book receipt accruals, reconcile Payables and accruals to GL, then close GL. The 26D Tables and Views guides document no purchasing-period table. The procurement side of close is receipt accounting, with period status in CMR_PERIOD_STATUSES on the GL calendar. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Payable Manager (Job Role, Payables Period Close duty); Cost Accountant (Job Role); Cash Manager (Job Role); General Accounting Manager (Job Role) |
| Where in the UI | Payables Period Close Workspace (26D agentic app; privileges Manage Payables Period Close Workspace and View Payables Period Close Workspace): select ledger and period, review close readiness, open the next period, sweep, close. The classic Payables period-close task is not named in the 26D topics (verify in your pod). Receipt Accounting work area: Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accruals task (Bill-to BU, period, cutoff date), Review Receipt Accounting Distributions (Transaction Type Period End Accrual). OTBI: Receipt Accounting Period End Validation Summary and Details. GL close and the combined P2P and O2C close sequence: 4.2 and 4.9. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES (APPLICATION_ID, LEDGER_ID, PERIOD_NAME), for both Payables and GL periods; CMR_PERIOD_STATUSES (BUSINESS_UNIT_ID, PERIOD_NAME); CMR_PERIOD_CLOSE_ACTIONS (BUSINESS_UNIT_ID, PERIOD_NAME, RUN_ID); CMR_ALL_PERIOD_VALERR_TXNS; CMR_ACCRUAL_SUMMARY (CMR_PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID); CMR_ACCR_RECONC_HEADERS (CMR_ACCR_RECONC_HEADER_ID); CMR_ACCRUAL_CLR_AMTS (ACCRUAL_CLR_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES.CLOSING_STATUS: O Open, F Future Enterable, C Closed, P Permanently Closed, N Never Opened (table description), plus W Close Pending (documented on the `accountingPeriodStatusLOV` REST resource, 11.2.1); OPEN_CLOSE_REQUESTED_STATUS for web-service requests: REQ_OPEN, SUCCESS_OPEN, REQ_CLOSE, SUCCESS_CLOSE. CMR_PERIOD_STATUSES.STATUS_CODE: N Never Opened, O Open, P Pending Close, C Closed, F Permanently Closed. |
| REST root resources | accountingPeriodsLOV; accountingPeriodStatusLOV; erpintegrations to run the close processes; payablesInterfaceInvoices to review and resubmit interface rows |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Close-specific processes and reports (the transaction processes are in 2.6 to 2.10). Payables: Payables Unaccounted Transactions and Sweep, Payables Period Close Exceptions Report, Prepare Payables to General Ledger Reconciliation, Payables to Ledger Reconciliation Report, Payables Trial Balance Report, Payables Posted Invoice Register, Payables Posted Payment Register, Payables Open Items Revaluation Report. Receipt accounting: Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual (Report or Accounting mode), Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual Report, Create Accrual Reversal Accounting, Run Receipt Accounting Period End Validations, Accrual Reconciliation Report, Match Receipt Accruals, Clear Receipt Accrual Balances, Accrual Clearing Report. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Sequence: (1) complete and approve transactions and payment files; (2) reconcile payments to the bank; (3) Create Accounting with Transfer to General Ledger set to Yes; (4) Unaccounted Transactions and Sweep; (5) close the Payables period and review the Period Close Exceptions report; (6) reconcile with the trial balance, registers and Payables to Ledger Reconciliation (run Prepare Payables to General Ledger Reconciliation first); (7) open the next period and run Create Mass Additions and Transfer Costs to Cost Management; (8) run Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual after the Payables period is closed and invoices are interfaced, and before GL close. Create Uninvoiced Receipt Accrual parameters: Bill to Business Unit, Accrual Run Mode (Report or Accounting), Accounting Period, Period End Accrual Cutoff and Accounting Date, Commit Limit, Include Purchase Order Status (default: open or closed for receiving). Report mode can run many times; after an Accounting-mode run, only Accounting mode is allowed for that period. If no cutoff date is entered, the last day of the period is used, and every run for a period must use the same cutoff date. The accruals reverse in the next period when Create Accrual Reversal Accounting is run there. Saved but unsubmitted Supplier Portal invoices block the Payables close: sweep them, or have an Accounts Payable Manager or Supervisor cancel them (Cancel Unsubmitted Invoices to Expedite Period Closure). GL can be prevented from closing while subledger periods are open (Using General Ledger, "How to Prevent a General Ledger Period from Closing When Open Subledger Periods Exist"). |

### 2.13 P2P data spine

The join chain below uses only documented foreign keys (the Foreign Keys sections of the 26D table pages) or explicit column comments. "FK" means a documented foreign key; the parent side is the parent's primary key. "Comment" means the join comes from the child column's comment. Where Oracle documents no link, the row says so. Appendix B lists every documented foreign key between the core tables.

| From table.column | To table.column | Cardinality | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID | POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID | N:1 | FK |
| POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID | POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID | N:1 | FK |
| PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID | POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.DISTRIBUTION_ID | N:0..1 | Comment: "Requisition distribution unique identifier" (the comment cites the pre-Fusion table name). Populated when the PO distribution is created from a requisition (table description) |

| PO_LINES_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID | PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID | N:1 | FK |
| PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID (also PO_HEADER_ID) | PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID | N:1 | FK |
| PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID | PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Document shipment schedule unique identifier. References ... LINE_LOCATION_ID" |
| PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID, PO_HEADER_ID | PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID, PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID | N:1 | Comment: "References PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID", "References PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID" |

Direct-delivery receipts are entered at distribution level, standard and inspection receipts at schedule level (Receipt Creation topic), so PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID can be empty |
