| AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID | PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID | N:0..1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.RCV_TRANSACTION_ID | RCV_TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTION_ID | N:0..1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICES_ALL.VENDOR_ID, PARTY_ID, PARTY_SITE_ID | POZ_SUPPLIERS.VENDOR_ID, HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID, HZ_PARTY_SITES.PARTY_SITE_ID | N:1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICES_ALL.VENDOR_SITE_ID | POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M.VENDOR_SITE_ID | N:1 | Not in the FK list. The comment says only "Physical location of the supplier" (verify in your pod) |
| AP_HOLDS_ALL.INVOICE_ID; LINE_LOCATION_ID; RCV_TRANSACTION_ID; HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE | AP_INVOICES_ALL; PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL; RCV_TRANSACTIONS; AP_HOLD_CODES | N:1 | FK; the RCV_TRANSACTION_ID comment also names RCV_TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTION_ID |
| AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.INVOICE_ID | AP_INVOICES_ALL.INVOICE_ID | N:1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.INVOICE_ID, PAYMENT_NUM | AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.INVOICE_ID, PAYMENT_NUM | N:1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.CHECK_ID | AP_CHECKS_ALL.CHECK_ID | N:1 | FK |
| AP_CHECKS_ALL.PAYMENT_ID | IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_ID | 1:1 | FK; comment "Oracle Payments payment identifier" |
| AP_CHECKS_ALL.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID; CHECKRUN_ID; CE_BANK_ACCT_USE_ID | IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL; AP_INV_SELECTION_CRITERIA_ALL; CE_BANK_ACCT_USES_ALL | N:1 | FK |
| IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.PAYMENT_ID | IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_ID | N:1 | FK |
| IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID | IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID | N:1 | FK |
| IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID, PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID | IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL, IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS | N:1 | FK |
| IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.CALLING_APP_DOC_UNIQUE_REF1 to REF5 | Payables source document | N:1 | Comment: "Source product's ... unique document payable Identifier". How these map to Payables keys is not documented (verify in your pod) |
| IBY_EXTERNAL_PAYEES_ALL.SUPPLIER_SITE_ID, PAYEE_PARTY_ID | POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M.VENDOR_SITE_ID, HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Supplier site Identifier", "TCA party Identifier" |
| IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_OWNER_PARTY_ID | IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID | N:1 | FK |
| AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID | XLA_EVENTS.EVENT_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Refers to the accounting event that accounted for the distribution" |
| AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID | XLA_EVENTS.EVENT_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Identifier for payment accounting event" |
| XLA_EVENTS.ENTITY_ID | XLA_TRANSACTION_ENTITIES.ENTITY_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Internal identified of the entity"; parent comment "Identifies subledger transactions associated with the accounting events"; parent PK ENTITY_ID (section 4) |
| XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS.EVENT_ID, APPLICATION_ID | XLA_EVENTS.EVENT_ID, APPLICATION_ID | N:1 | Same EVENT_ID comment on both tables; parent PK (EVENT_ID, APPLICATION_ID) |
| XLA_AE_LINES.AE_HEADER_ID, APPLICATION_ID | XLA_AE_HEADERS.AE_HEADER_ID, APPLICATION_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Identifier of accounting entry" on both tables; parent PK (AE_HEADER_ID, APPLICATION_ID) |
| XLA_AE_HEADERS.EVENT_ID | XLA_EVENTS.EVENT_ID | N:1 | Same EVENT_ID comment on both tables |
| XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS.AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM; SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_1 | XLA_AE_LINES.AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM; source distribution | N:1 | Comment: "Subledger journal entry identifier / line number"; "Transaction source distribution identifier". For Payables the source distribution is the invoice distribution (verify SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE in your pod) |
| XLA_AE_LINES.GL_SL_LINK_ID, GL_SL_LINK_TABLE | GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES.GL_SL_LINK_ID, GL_SL_LINK_TABLE | N:1 | Comment: "Audit trail from subledger application to general ledger" |
| GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES.JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM | GL_JE_LINES.JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM | N:1 | FK |
| CMR_RCV_TRANSACTIONS.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID | RCV_TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTION_ID | 1:1 (character key) | Comment: "Receiving Transaction Unique Identifier in the Source System" |
| CMR_RCV_EVENTS.CMR_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID | CMR_RCV_TRANSACTIONS.CMR_RCV_TRANSACTION_ID | N:1 | Comment: "Single Column FK" |
| CMR_RCV_DISTRIBUTIONS.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID | CMR_RCV_EVENTS.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID | N:1 | FK |
| CMR_AP_INVOICE_DTLS.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_REF_ID | AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID | 1:1 (character key) | Comment: "Identifier of the AP Invoice distribution line in the source system" |

The query below traces one purchase order through the whole spine. It is a diagnostic query for one PO, not a report. The CTEs aggregate receipts, holds, payments and accounting so the grain stays at one row per PO distribution and matched invoice distribution. It uses Oracle Database 19c syntax (LISTAGG DISTINCT). Bind `:payables_application_id` to the Payables application ID (200 in published Fusion queries; confirm with the XLA_SUBLEDGERS query in 4.1.2 or helper H1 in 9.1).

```sql
WITH po AS (
  SELECT pda.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID, pda.LINE_LOCATION_ID
  FROM   PO_HEADERS_ALL ph
  JOIN   PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL pda ON pda.PO_HEADER_ID = ph.PO_HEADER_ID
  WHERE  ph.SEGMENT1 = :po_number
  AND    ph.PRC_BU_ID = :prc_bu_id
),
inv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT aid.INVOICE_ID
  FROM   AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid
  WHERE  aid.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID IN (SELECT po.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID FROM po)
),
rcv AS (
  SELECT rt.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID,
         LISTAGG(DISTINCT rsh.RECEIPT_NUM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rsh.RECEIPT_NUM) AS receipt_numbers,
         COUNT(*) AS receiving_txns,
         SUM(CASE WHEN rt.ACCRUAL_STATUS_CODE = 'INTERFACED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS txns_not_in_costing,
         MAX(rsl.SHIPMENT_LINE_STATUS_CODE) AS shipment_line_status
  FROM   RCV_TRANSACTIONS rt
  JOIN   RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES rsl   ON rsl.SHIPMENT_LINE_ID   = rt.SHIPMENT_LINE_ID
  JOIN   RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS rsh ON rsh.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID = rsl.SHIPMENT_HEADER_ID
  WHERE  rt.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID IN (SELECT po.LINE_LOCATION_ID FROM po)
  GROUP  BY rt.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID
),
hld AS (
  SELECT ah.INVOICE_ID,
         LISTAGG(DISTINCT ah.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ah.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE) AS open_holds
  FROM   AP_HOLDS_ALL ah
  WHERE  ah.RELEASE_LOOKUP_CODE IS NULL
  AND    ah.INVOICE_ID IN (SELECT inv.INVOICE_ID FROM inv)
  GROUP  BY ah.INVOICE_ID
),
pay AS (
  SELECT aps.INVOICE_ID,
         MAX(aps.HOLD_FLAG) AS installment_hold,
         MIN(aps.DUE_DATE)  AS first_due_date,
         LISTAGG(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(ac.CHECK_NUMBER), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TO_CHAR(ac.CHECK_NUMBER)) AS payment_numbers,
         MAX(ac.STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE)              AS payables_payment_status,
         MAX(ac.CLEARED_DATE)                    AS cleared_date,
         MAX(ipa.PAYMENT_STATUS)                 AS payments_payment_status,
         MAX(ipi.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_STATUS)     AS payment_file_status,
         MAX(ipr.CALL_APP_PAY_SERVICE_REQ_CODE)  AS ppr_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT idp.DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_ID) AS documents_in_payments
  FROM   AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL aps
  LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL aip  ON aip.INVOICE_ID = aps.INVOICE_ID AND aip.PAYMENT_NUM = aps.PAYMENT_NUM
  LEFT JOIN AP_CHECKS_ALL ac             ON ac.CHECK_ID = aip.CHECK_ID
  LEFT JOIN IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL ipa         ON ipa.PAYMENT_ID = ac.PAYMENT_ID
  LEFT JOIN IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL idp     ON idp.PAYMENT_ID = ipa.PAYMENT_ID
  LEFT JOIN IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL ipi ON ipi.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID = ipa.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
  LEFT JOIN IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS ipr ON ipr.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID = ipa.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
  WHERE  aps.INVOICE_ID IN (SELECT inv.INVOICE_ID FROM inv)
  GROUP  BY aps.INVOICE_ID
),
acct AS (
  SELECT d.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID,
         MAX(xe.EVENT_STATUS_CODE)             AS event_status,
         MAX(xte.TRANSACTION_NUMBER)           AS sla_transaction_number,
         MAX(xah.ACCOUNTING_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE) AS sla_entry_status,
         MAX(xah.GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE)      AS transfer_to_gl_status,
         MAX(gjh.NAME)                         AS journal_name
  FROM   AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL d
  JOIN   XLA_EVENTS xe                ON xe.EVENT_ID = d.ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID
                                     AND xe.APPLICATION_ID = :payables_application_id
  JOIN   XLA_TRANSACTION_ENTITIES xte ON xte.ENTITY_ID = xe.ENTITY_ID AND xte.APPLICATION_ID = xe.APPLICATION_ID
  JOIN   XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS xdl   ON xdl.EVENT_ID = xe.EVENT_ID AND xdl.APPLICATION_ID = xe.APPLICATION_ID
                                     AND xdl.SOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_ID_NUM_1 = d.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
  JOIN   XLA_AE_LINES xal             ON xal.AE_HEADER_ID = xdl.AE_HEADER_ID AND xal.AE_LINE_NUM = xdl.AE_LINE_NUM
                                     AND xal.APPLICATION_ID = xdl.APPLICATION_ID
  JOIN   XLA_AE_HEADERS xah           ON xah.AE_HEADER_ID = xal.AE_HEADER_ID AND xah.APPLICATION_ID = xal.APPLICATION_ID
  LEFT JOIN GL_IMPORT_REFERENCES gir  ON gir.GL_SL_LINK_ID = xal.GL_SL_LINK_ID AND gir.GL_SL_LINK_TABLE = xal.GL_SL_LINK_TABLE
  LEFT JOIN GL_JE_LINES gjl           ON gjl.JE_HEADER_ID = gir.JE_HEADER_ID AND gjl.JE_LINE_NUM = gir.JE_LINE_NUM
  LEFT JOIN GL_JE_HEADERS gjh         ON gjh.JE_HEADER_ID = gjl.JE_HEADER_ID
  WHERE  d.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID IN (SELECT po.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID FROM po)
  GROUP  BY d.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
)
SELECT rqh.REQUISITION_NUMBER,
       rql.LINE_NUMBER             AS req_line,
       rql.LINE_STATUS             AS req_line_status,
       ph.SEGMENT1                 AS po_number,
       ph.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE         AS document_type,
       ph.DOCUMENT_STATUS          AS po_status,
       hp.PARTY_NAME               AS supplier_name,
       sup.SEGMENT1                AS supplier_number,
       sit.VENDOR_SITE_CODE        AS supplier_site,
       pl.LINE_NUM                 AS order_line,
       pll.SHIPMENT_NUM            AS schedule_num,
       pda.DISTRIBUTION_NUM        AS order_distribution,
       pll.MATCH_OPTION,
       pll.RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG,
       pll.INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG,
       pda.ACCRUE_ON_RECEIPT_FLAG,
       pll.QUANTITY                AS schedule_qty,
       pll.QUANTITY_RECEIVED,
       pll.QUANTITY_BILLED,
       rcv.receipt_numbers,
       rcv.txns_not_in_costing,
       ai.INVOICE_NUM,
       ai.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS invoice_type,
       ai.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS        AS invoice_approval,
       ai.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG      AS invoice_paid_flag,
       ail.LINE_NUMBER             AS invoice_line,
       ail.MATCH_TYPE,
       aid.LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE   AS dist_type,
       aid.AMOUNT                  AS dist_amount,
       aid.MATCH_STATUS_FLAG,
       aid.POSTED_FLAG,
       rtm.TRANSACTION_ID          AS matched_receipt_txn,
       hld.open_holds,
       (SELECT SUM(s.AMOUNT_REMAINING) FROM AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL s WHERE s.INVOICE_ID = ai.INVOICE_ID) AS amount_remaining,
       pay.installment_hold,
       pay.payment_numbers,
       pay.payables_payment_status,
       pay.payments_payment_status,
       pay.payment_file_status,
       pay.ppr_name,
       pay.cleared_date,
       acct.sla_entry_status,
       acct.transfer_to_gl_status,
       acct.journal_name
FROM   PO_HEADERS_ALL ph
JOIN   POZ_SUPPLIERS sup                   ON sup.VENDOR_ID = ph.VENDOR_ID
JOIN   HZ_PARTIES hp                       ON hp.PARTY_ID = sup.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M sit     ON sit.VENDOR_SITE_ID = ph.VENDOR_SITE_ID
JOIN   PO_LINES_ALL pl                     ON pl.PO_HEADER_ID = ph.PO_HEADER_ID
JOIN   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL pll           ON pll.PO_LINE_ID = pl.PO_LINE_ID
JOIN   PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL pda            ON pda.LINE_LOCATION_ID = pll.LINE_LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN POR_REQ_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL rqd    ON rqd.DISTRIBUTION_ID = pda.REQ_DISTRIBUTION_ID
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL rql    ON rql.REQUISITION_LINE_ID = rqd.REQUISITION_LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL rqh  ON rqh.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = rql.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN rcv                              ON rcv.PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID = pll.LINE_LOCATION_ID
LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL aid ON aid.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID = pda.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL ail         ON ail.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID AND ail.LINE_NUMBER = aid.INVOICE_LINE_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN AP_INVOICES_ALL ai               ON ai.INVOICE_ID = aid.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN RCV_TRANSACTIONS rtm             ON rtm.TRANSACTION_ID = aid.RCV_TRANSACTION_ID
LEFT JOIN hld                              ON hld.INVOICE_ID = ai.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN pay                              ON pay.INVOICE_ID = ai.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN acct                             ON acct.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID = aid.INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
WHERE  ph.SEGMENT1 = :po_number
AND    ph.PRC_BU_ID = :prc_bu_id
ORDER  BY pl.LINE_NUM, pll.SHIPMENT_NUM, pda.DISTRIBUTION_NUM, ai.INVOICE_NUM, ail.LINE_NUMBER;
```

Notes on the query:

- Treating `RELEASE_LOOKUP_CODE IS NULL` as "unreleased" follows the column comment ("Release name that released the hold"). The table description warns that the same hold type can be placed, released and placed again on an invoice; the documented primary key is HOLD_ID.
- Receipts are aggregated per schedule (PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID). Standard and inspection receipts are entered at schedule level, so their receiving transactions may carry no PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID.
- Distribution-level accounting goes through XLA_DISTRIBUTION_LINKS. Header-level questions, such as "is this invoice fully accounted", are answered faster from POSTED_FLAG. More SQL is in section 9.
- This query is the wide diagnostic view (one row per PO distribution and matched invoice distribution). For a timeline with one row per document, use section 9, Q1; for the invoice-to-GL drill-down alone, use Q7.

### 2.14 Status and lifecycle reference

Codes in capitals are stored values documented in column comments. Mixed-case values are UI labels from the cited topic. Where only UI labels are documented, decode the stored codes with AP_LOOKUP_CODES, PO_LOOKUP_CODES or FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_B, or profile them with `SELECT DISTINCT` in your pod.

| Object | Table.column | Values and meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Requisition | POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS | Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected, Returned (all active lines returned by the buyer), Withdrawn, Canceled. The header status rolls up from the active lines | [Requisition Status](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oaprc/requisition-status.html) |
| Requisition import | POR_REQ_HEADERS_INTERFACE_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS | INCOMPLETE, APPROVED | Column comment |
| Requisition line | POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.LINE_STATUS | INCOMPLETE, PENDING APPROVAL, REJECTED, RETURNED, WITHDRAWN, CANCELED (named in the header HAS_*_LINES and LOCKED_BY_BUYER_FLAG comments). The UI also shows split and replaced lines | Column comments; Requisition Status |
| Requisition life cycle | LIFECYCLE_STATUS (header and line), LIFECYCLE_SECONDARY_STATUS (line) | Rolled-up life-cycle codes; the value list is not documented (verify in your pod) | Column comments |
| Funds | FUNDS_STATUS on requisition, PO header, line, schedule and distribution, and on invoices | Not Applicable when no control budget applies; other values: verify in your pod | [How Funds Are Reserved for Requisitions](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oaprc/how-funds-are-reserved-for-requisitions.html) |
| Purchase order | PO_HEADERS_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS | Incomplete, Pending Approval, Open, Pending Acknowledgment (the acknowledgment topic calls it Pending Supplier Acknowledgment), Pending Change Approval, Pending Signature, Sent for Signature, On Hold, Closed for Receiving, Closed for Invoicing, Closed, Finally Closed, Canceled, Rejected, Withdrawn | [Purchase Order Statuses](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oaprc/purchase-order-statuses.html) |
| Document type | PO_HEADERS_ALL.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE (comment: references PO_DOCUMENT_TYPES_ALL_B.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE; unique with SEGMENT1 and BU) | STANDARD, BLANKET, CONTRACT | PO_DOC_STYLE_LINES_B.DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE and PO_CO_TEMPLATES_B.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE comments |
| Change order | PO_VERSIONS.CHANGE_ORDER_STATUS | DRAFT, PENDING APPROVAL, PENDING ACCEPTANCE, PENDING SIGNATURE, PRE-APPROVED, PROCESSED | Column comment |
| Schedule closure | PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.CLOSED_FOR_RECEIVING_DATE, CLOSED_FOR_INVOICE_DATE, SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE | Closed for Receiving once the receipt close tolerance and receipt close point are met; Closed for Invoicing once the invoice close tolerance is met. Neither blocks further receipts or matching. Closure rolls up schedule > line > header | [What happens if a purchase order is closed?](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oaprc/what-happens-if-a-purchase-order-is-closed.html) |
| Match level | PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG, INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG | Receipt not required: 2-way. Receipt required: 3-way. Receipt and inspection required: 4-way. Derived from the column comments and the match level definitions | [Match Approval Level Options](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/procurement/26d/oapro/match-approval-level-options.html) |
| Receipt header, line and routing | RCV_SHIPMENT_HEADERS.RECEIPT_SOURCE_CODE, ASN_TYPE; RCV_SHIPMENT_LINES.SHIPMENT_LINE_STATUS_CODE; ROUTING_HEADER_ID | Values in 2.5 | Column comments |
| Receiving transaction | RCV_TRANSACTIONS.TRANSACTION_TYPE | Codes come from the receiving transaction-type lookup named in the comment. Receipt Accounting lists them as Receive, Deliver, Return to Vendor, Return to Receiving, Correction to Receipt, Correction to Deliver, Match (CMR_RCV_EVENT_TYPES.TRANSACTION_TYPE comment). The interface AUTO_TRANSACT_CODE takes SHIP, RECEIVE, DELIVER | Column comments |
| Inspection; costing interface | RCV_TRANSACTIONS.INSPECTION_STATUS_CODE; ACCRUAL_STATUS_CODE | NOT INSPECTED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED; PENDING, INTERFACED, ERROR | Column comments; [Transfer Transactions from Receiving to Costing](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/supply-chain-and-manufacturing/26d/faspc/transfer-transactions-from-receiving-to-costing.html) |
| Receiving interface | RCV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE.PROCESSING_STATUS_CODE and TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE; PROCESSING_MODE_CODE; RCV_HEADERS_INTERFACE.PROCESSING_STATUS_CODE | PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR; PENDING, IMMEDIATE, BATCH; PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, ERROR | Column comments |
| Invoice type | AP_INVOICES_ALL.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE (lookup type INVOICE TYPE) | Standard, Prepayment, Credit memo, Debit memo, Withholding tax, Interest, Standard invoice request, Credit memo invoice request, Payment request | [Invoice Types](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/invoice-types.html) |
| Invoice validation | Derived (no documented status column); REST ValidationStatus; AP_INVOICES_ALL.FORCE_REVALIDATION_FLAG; unreleased AP_HOLDS_ALL rows | Validated; Not Validated (REST default); Needs revalidation (verify in your pod). Which stored columns drive the derived status is not documented in 26D | [How Invoices Are Validated](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/how-invoices-are-validated.html); [Get an invoice (REST)](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/farfa/op-invoices-invoicesuniqid-get.html) |
| Invoice approval | AP_INVOICES_ALL.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS; AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS | Required, Initiated, Held from approval, Workflow approved, Manually approved, Rejected, Withdrawn, Resubmit for approval | [Considerations for Approval Actions](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/considerations-for-approval-actions.html) |
| Invoice paid | AP_INVOICES_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG; AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG | Y fully paid, N unpaid, P partially paid. REST PaidStatus defaults to Unpaid | Column comment; table description |
| Accounted | AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.POSTED_FLAG; AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.POSTED_FLAG; AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL.POSTED_FLAG | Y accounted, N unaccounted | Table descriptions |
| Canceled or discarded | AP_INVOICES_ALL.CANCELLED_DATE; AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL.CANCELLED_FLAG, DISCARDED_FLAG | Date populated or Y. A discarded line has amount 0 and its distributions reversed | Column comments |
| Holds | AP_HOLDS_ALL.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE, RELEASE_LOOKUP_CODE (null until released) | Matching: AMT ORD, AMT REC, MAX AMT ORD, MAX AMT REC, MILESTONE, Can't Close PO, Can't Try Final Close, Final Matching, Matching Required, Max Qty Ord, Max Qty Rec, Max Rate Amount, Max Ship Amount, Max Total Amount, Price, Qty Ord, Qty Rec, Quality, Rec Exception, Tax Difference. Variance: Dist Variance, Prepaid Amount, Tax Amount Range, Tax Variance. Account: Dist Acct Invalid, ERV Acct Invalid. Funds: Funds Check, Insufficient Funds. Invoice: Amount, Invalid PO, Natural Account Tax, Pay When Paid, PO Deliverable, Supplier, Withholding Tax. Supplier site: Invoice amount limit, Unmatched invoices, Unvalidated invoices. Miscellaneous: No Rate, Supplier; All Payments blocks payment without placing an invoice hold. Manual release rules per hold are in the source | [Types of Holds](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/types-of-holds.html) |
| Payment process request | IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS | Stored codes include PAYMENTS_CREATED. UI stages: Installment selection (Pending installments review, Missing payment conversion rates), Document validation (Pending action to address document validation errors), Payment validation (Pending proposed payment review), Payment file build (Waiting for payment file processing), Terminated (No available installments, Failed document validation) | Column comment; [How Payment Process Requests Are Processed](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/how-payment-process-requests-are-processed.html) |
| Document payable; payment; payment file | IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS; IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS; IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL.PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_STATUS | Stored codes include PAYMENT CREATED; CREATED, FORMATTED, TRANSMITTED; CREATED, FORMATTED, TRANSMITTED. UI file statuses for printed files: Formatted and ready for printing, Submitted for printing, Printed | Column comments; [Check Payments](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/faipp/set-up-and-make-check-payments.html) |
| Payables payment | AP_CHECKS_ALL.STATUS_LOOKUP_CODE | Stored code examples NEGOTIABLE, SET UP, SPOILED. UI statuses: Negotiable, Issued (bills payable not yet matured), Stop initiated, Voided, Cleared (reconciled in Cash Management) | Column comment; [How Payment Statuses Change](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/how-payment-statuses-change.html) |
| Payment type | AP_CHECKS_ALL.PAYMENT_TYPE_FLAG | Payment process request, Quick, Manual, Refund | [Considerations for Payment Types](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/financials/26d/fappp/considerations-for-payment-types.html) |
| Payment history | AP_PAYMENT_HISTORY_ALL.TRANSACTION_TYPE | PAYMENT MATURITY, PAYMENT CLEARING, PAYMENT UNCLEARING | Column comment |

Bank statement, subledger accounting and period statuses are listed in 2.10, 2.11 and 2.12.

### 2.15 Common P2P exceptions and where to look

| Symptom | Likely cause | Tables and columns to check | UI place to resolve |
|---|---|---|---|
| Approved requisition line has no PO | Touchless conversion failed; line waiting in the buyer queue; Generate Orders not run | POR_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.REQTOPO_AUTOMATION_FAILED, REQTOPO_AUTO_FAILED_REASON, ASSIGNED_BUYER_ID, PO_HEADER_ID (null) | Purchase Orders work area > Process Requisitions; Scheduled Processes > Generate Orders |
| Requisition or PO rejected on funds check | No budget available or budget date outside the control budget | FUNDS_STATUS on the requisition and PO header, line, schedule and distribution; POR_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL.FUNDS_CHK_FAIL_WARN_FLAG, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_FLAG; budgetaryControlResults REST resource (GET) | Request a funds override (privilege required); budget owner adjusts the control budget |
| Supplier site not available on a PO or invoice for a BU | No active site assignment for the client BU, or the site or purpose is inactive | POZ_SITE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL_M.BU_ID, BILL_TO_BU_ID, INACTIVE_DATE; POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M.INACTIVE_DATE, PURCHASING_SITE_FLAG, PAY_SITE_FLAG | Suppliers work area > Edit Supplier > Sites > Site Assignments |
| Receipt from integration, mobile or FBDI not created | Validation error in the receiving open interface | RCV_TRANSACTIONS_INTERFACE.PROCESSING_STATUS_CODE, TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE (ERROR); RCV_INTERFACE_ERRORS.ERROR_MESSAGE, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME | Inventory Management work area > Review Receipts Interface; rerun Manage Receiving Transactions |
| Receipt missing from accruals or accrual reports | Receiving transactions not transferred to costing, or transfer errors | RCV_TRANSACTIONS.ACCRUAL_STATUS_CODE (PENDING, ERROR); CMR_RCV_INTF_TXNS_ERRORS.ERROR_MESSAGE; CMR_RCV_EVENTS.ACCOUNTED_FLAG; CMR_PROCESS_ERRORS | Scheduled Processes > Transfer Transactions from Receiving to Costing; Receipt Accounting work area > Create and Review Receipt Accounting Distributions |
| Invoice on Qty Rec, Qty Ord or Price hold | Billed above received or ordered quantity, or above PO price, beyond tolerance; goods not yet received | AP_HOLDS_ALL.HOLD_LOOKUP_CODE, LINE_LOCATION_ID, RCV_TRANSACTION_ID; PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.QUANTITY, QUANTITY_RECEIVED, QUANTITY_BILLED; AP_INVOICE_LINES_ALL.UNIT_PRICE against PO_LINES_ALL.UNIT_PRICE; AP_TOLERANCE_TEMPLATES through POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M.TOLERANCE_ID | Receive, then Validate again; or correct the invoice, raise a PO change order, or release on Manage Invoices > Release Holds; holds resolution workflow notifications |
| Imported invoices missing | Rows rejected by Import Payables Invoices | AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE.STATUS, LOAD_REQUEST_ID; AP_INTERFACE_REJECTIONS.PARENT_TABLE, PARENT_ID, REJECT_LOOKUP_CODE | Correct Import Errors task (spreadsheet), then resubmit; payablesInterfaceInvoices REST action interfaceRejections |
| Validated invoice not picked by a payment process request | Approval not complete; unreleased hold; installment hold; supplier site Hold all payments; due date or pay group outside the selection criteria | AP_INVOICES_ALL.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS, PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE; AP_HOLDS_ALL; AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL.HOLD_FLAG, DUE_DATE, PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG; POZ_SUPPLIER_SITES_ALL_M.HOLD_ALL_PAYMENTS_FLAG | Invoices landing page (Approvals, Holds); Payments > Submit Payment Process Request (selection criteria) and Review Installments |
| Payment process request stops or terminates | Bank account or profile could not be assigned; document or payment validation errors; waiting for review | IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS.PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS; IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL.DOCUMENT_STATUS; IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL.PAYMENT_STATUS | Payments Overview > Requiring Attention (Assign Payment Process Attributes, Resume Payment Process); Manage Payment Process Requests |
| Payables period won't close; unaccounted items | Invoices or payments not accounted or in error; accounting events on hold; saved but unsubmitted Supplier Portal invoices | AP_INVOICE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.POSTED_FLAG = N; AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL.POSTED_FLAG; XLA_EVENTS.PROCESS_STATUS_CODE, ON_HOLD_FLAG; XLA_AE_HEADERS.GL_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE | Create Accounting (Process Events = Errors), Payables Unaccounted Transactions and Sweep, Period Close Exceptions report; Payables Period Close Workspace |

## 3. Order-to-Cash (O2C) end to end

This section follows one sales order from customer master data to cleared cash and a closed period. Each step shows the purpose, job roles, UI entry point, tables, status columns, REST resources, bulk and scheduled-process interfaces, and controls. Conventions:

- Tables are written TABLE (PK). REST resource names are roots under `/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/` unless marked `/crmRestApi`.
- "(verify in your pod)" marks values that Oracle does not document precisely or that depend on your setup.
- Related sections: interface mechanics in 6 and 7, accounting backbone in 4, SQL patterns in 9, Oracle AI agents in 10, Claude Code in 11, security in 12.

### O2C flow at a glance

| # | Step | Business event | Primary document and table | Accounting impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Customer setup (3.1) | Party, account, bill-to and ship-to sites, and profile created | Customer account: HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL | None |
| 2 | Pricing (3.2) | Price list, strategy, segment and discounts resolved per line | Price list QP_PRICE_LISTS_ALL_B; order charges DOO_ORDER_CHARGES | None |
| 3 | Order capture (3.3) | Order entered or imported, priced, credit-checked, approved, submitted | Sales order DOO_HEADERS_ALL, DOO_LINES_ALL | None. Credit authorization stored in AR_CUST_CREDIT_AUTHORIZATION |
| 4 | Orchestration (3.4) | Fulfillment lines scheduled and reserved; supply created for drop ship and back-to-back | DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL, INV_RESERVATIONS, DOS_SUPPLY_LINES | None for stock orders. Drop ship: receipt and cost accounting on a logical receipt |
| 5 | Shipping (3.5) | Pick wave released, picks confirmed, shipment confirmed, inventory issued | Shipment WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES, WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS; INV_MATERIAL_TXNS | Cost Management. Ship-and-bill: Dr Deferred COGS, Cr Inventory valuation (verify the accounts in your pod). Ship-only: 100% COGS at issue |
| 6 | Billing (3.6) | Billing line interfaced; Import AutoInvoice creates the invoice | RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL to RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL | Dr Receivable; Cr Revenue, or Unearned Revenue (deferred rules), or Revenue Clearing (Revenue Management); Cr Tax, Freight |
| 7 | Revenue recognition (3.7) | Revenue recognized by schedule (Receivables) or by satisfaction (Revenue Management) | RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ALL or VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_LINES | Receivables: Dr Unearned Revenue, Cr Revenue. Revenue Management: Dr Contract Liability, Cr Contract Revenue. Cost: Dr COGS, Cr Deferred COGS in the same proportion |
| 8 | Credit and collections (3.8) | Credit review, delinquency, dunning, promise to pay, dispute | AR_CMGT_CASE_FOLDERS, IEX_DELINQUENCIES_ALL, IEX_PROMISE_DETAILS | None until an adjustment or credit memo |
| 9 | Receipts (3.9) | Receipt created (manual, lockbox, automatic, REST) and applied | AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL, AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL | Receipt: Dr Cash, Remittance or Confirmation (per receipt class), Cr Unapplied. Application: Dr Unapplied, Cr Receivable |
| 10 | Adjustments and credits (3.10) | Adjustment, credit memo, write-off, refund | AR_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL; credit memo rows in RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL | Adjustment: Dr activity account, Cr Receivable. Credit memo: Dr Revenue and Tax, Cr Receivable |
| 11 | Accounting (3.11) | Subledger journals created and transferred | XLA_EVENTS, XLA_AE_HEADERS, XLA_AE_LINES to GL_JE_HEADERS, GL_JE_LINES | Final journals in the ledger |
| 12 | Bank reconciliation (3.12) | Statement line matched; receipt cleared | CE_STATEMENT_LINES, CE_RECON_HISTORY | Clearance: Dr Cash, Cr Remittance (accounts from the receipt class and bank account) |
| 13 | Period close (3.13) | AR reconciled to GL; Receivables, Cost Management and GL periods closed | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES | None |

Account names in the last column come from AutoAccounting, receipt classes, cost accounting rules and Subledger Accounting rules in your pod.

### 3.1 Customer setup

The Customer Data Model (TCA) chain is: party, customer account, account site on a party site and location, site uses (business purposes), contacts, and profiles defaulted from profile classes.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Create the selling relationship. A sales transaction needs a party with a customer account and an account site with a Bill-to purpose. Profiles hold credit, collector, payment terms, statement, dunning, late charge and receipt-matching settings. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Receivable Specialist and Accounts Receivable Manager (Billing work area); Credit Manager (credit profile). Order Entry Specialist consumes the data. |
| Where in the UI | Navigator > Receivables > Billing > Tasks pane > Customers > Manage Customers: create and edit customer, account, site, profile (customers can also be managed from the Collections work area). Credit Management work area: credit profiles. Setup and Maintenance > Manage Receivables Customer Profile Classes. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID); HZ_PARTY_SITES (PARTY_SITE_ID); HZ_LOCATIONS (LOCATION_ID); HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS (CUST_ACCOUNT_ID); HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL (CUST_ACCT_SITE_ID); HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL (SITE_USE_ID); HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLES (CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ID); HZ_RELATIONSHIPS (RELATIONSHIP_REC_ID); HZ_ORG_CONTACTS (ORG_CONTACT_ID); HZ_CONTACT_POINTS (CONTACT_POINT_ID); HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F (CUST_ACCOUNT_PROFILE_ID, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE); HZ_CUST_PROFILE_AMTS_F (CUST_ACCT_PROFILE_AMT_ID, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, EFFECTIVE_END_DATE); HZ_CUST_PROFILE_CLASSES (PROFILE_CLASS_ID); HZ_CUST_PROF_CLASS_AMTS (PROFILE_CLASS_AMOUNT_ID); HZ_ORIG_SYS_REFERENCES (ORIG_SYSTEM_REF_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | STATUS on HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS, HZ_CUST_ACCT_SITES_ALL and HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL (lookup CODE_STATUS; A active and I inactive are the usual codes, verify in your pod); party and party site status flags on HZ_PARTIES.STATUS and HZ_PARTY_SITES.STATUS. HZ_LOCATIONS.STATUS_FLAG (A, I). HZ_CUST_SITE_USES_ALL.SITE_USE_CODE (BILL_TO, SHIP_TO and other purposes) and PRIMARY_FLAG. HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS.CUSTOMER_TYPE (I internal, R external). HZ_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_F.CREDIT_CHECKING and CREDIT_HOLD (Y/N); profile rows are date-effective. |
| REST root resources | `/crmRestApi`: `hubOrganizations` (party, addresses, address purposes, contact points, source system references, `findDuplicates` action), `accounts`, `contacts`. fscm: `receivablesCustomerAccountActivities` and `receivablesCustomerAccountSiteActivities` (balances and activity, contact actions), `customerAccountSitesLOV`, `partyTaxProfiles`. Order Management "Customer for Sales Orders" service creates sold-to, ship-to and bill-to data in one call: `POST /fscmRestApi/fom/11.13.18.05/customerForSalesOrders/createCustomer`. Example: `GET /crmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/hubOrganizations`. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Customer Import (CustomerImportTemplate.xlsm; HZ_IMP_PARTIES_T and the other import tables on the template page, RA_CUSTOMER_PROFILES_INT_ALL, RA_CUSTOMER_BANKS_INT_ALL, RA_CUST_PAY_METHOD_INT_ALL): run Load Interface File for Import with import process Import Trading Community Data in Bulk. Upload Customers (UploadCustomersTemplate.xlsm; AR_UPD_CUSTOMERS, AR_UPD_CONTACTS, AR_UPD_BANK_ACCOUNTS, AR_UPD_REF_ACCOUNTS) is a simplified load of customer data only, without Trading Community registry data. The FBDI page names its process Upload Customers; Implementing Receivables calls it Upload Customers from Spreadsheet. SOAP Customer Profile service (section 7). |
| Key controls and exceptions | New accounts get profile class DEFAULT; new sites get none until you assign one. Profile changes are date-effective and the transaction or receipt date picks the version. Account sites and site uses carry SET_ID (reference data set); a business unit uses the sites in the set assigned to it (verify set assignments in your pod). Order import cannot create customers: the CreateCustomerInformationFlag attribute can no longer be set, so an order whose customer is missing fails import. Create the customer first, for example with the Customer for Sales Orders service. Store source keys in HZ_ORIG_SYS_REFERENCES and check duplicates before loading. |

### 3.2 Pricing

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Price each order line from price lists, discount lists and shipping charge lists. Customer Pricing ("Redwood: Set Up Customer Pricing", no longer optional from 26D) is evaluated first: customer, then customer group, then the all-customers group. If nothing matches, pricing falls back to customer pricing profiles, pricing segments and strategy assignment rules. The result is stored on the order as charges and charge components. |
| Typical job roles | Pricing Administrator, Pricing Manager, Pricing Analyst; Order Entry Specialist for manual price adjustments. |
| Where in the UI | Pricing Administration work area: price lists, discount lists, pricing strategies. Customer Pricing setup in Redwood (page name: verify in your pod). Redwood pages for segment pricing profiles and pricing segments, opened from the Pricing Administration landing page and enabled by a Redwood profile option (described in 26C readiness; verify in your pod). Order Management work area: Edit Price on Order Lines. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | QP_PRICE_LISTS_ALL_B (PRICE_LIST_ID); QP_PRICE_LIST_ITEMS (PRICE_LIST_ITEM_ID); QP_PRICE_LIST_CHARGES (PRICE_LIST_CHARGE_ID); QP_DISCOUNT_LISTS_ALL_B (DISCOUNT_LIST_ID); QP_DISCOUNT_LIST_ITEMS (DISCOUNT_LIST_ITEM_ID); QP_SHIPPING_CHARGE_LISTS_ALL_B (SHIPPING_CHARGE_LIST_ID); QP_PRICING_STRATEGIES_ALL_B (PRICING_STRATEGY_ID); QP_PRICING_STRATEGY_DETAILS (PRICING_STRATEGY_DETAIL_ID); QP_STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENTS (STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT_ID); QP_MATRICES (DYNAMIC_MATRIX_ID) and QP_MATRIX_RULES (DYNAMIC_MATRIX_RULE_ID) for segment and assignment rules; QP_CUST_PRICING_PROFILES (CUSTOMER_PRICING_PROFILE_ID); QP_CUST_PRICING_DEFNS_B (CUST_PRICING_DEFN_ID) and QP_CUST_PRICING_DEFN_DTLS (CUST_PRICING_DEFN_DETL_ID) for Customer Pricing. Order side: DOO_ORDER_CHARGES (ORDER_CHARGE_ID); DOO_ORDER_CHARGE_COMPONENTS (ORDER_CHARGE_COMPONENT_ID); DOO_PRICE_ADJUSTMENTS (PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_ID); DOO_MANUAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENTS (MANUAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_ID); DOO_ORDER_TOTALS (ORDER_TOTAL_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | QP_PRICE_LISTS_ALL_B.STATUS_CODE (active or not); ENTITY_APPRV_STATUS_CODE (ORA_DRAFT, ORA_PENDING_APPROVAL, ORA_APPROVED, ORA_REJECTED; null means approved); PRICE_LIST_TYPE_CODE (CEILING, SEGMENT, GSA); START_DATE and END_DATE. DOO_HEADERS_ALL: PRICING_SEGMENT_CODE, PRICING_STRATEGY_ID, PRICED_ON, FREEZE_PRICE_FLAG. |
| REST root resources | `priceLists`, `discountLists`, `shippingChargeLists`, `pricingStrategies`, `pricingStrategyAssignments`, `pricingSegments`, `customerPricingProfiles`, `pricingMatrixes`, `manualPriceAdjustments`, `priceBooks`, `priceBookRetrievals` |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Price List, Price Lists Batch, Discount Lists, Cost Lists. Scheduled processes Import Price Lists Batch, Import Discount Lists, Import Cost Lists, Delete Pricing Data from Interface Tables; Refresh Pricing and Integration Algorithms; Generate Price Book; Maintain Price Books. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Approval flow on price lists and matrixes (ENTITY_APPRV_STATUS_CODE). Segment and assignment columns must exist in Manage Matrix Classes (classes Pricing Segment and Sales Pricing Strategy Assignment). DOO_HEADERS_ALL.PRICING_SEGMENT_EXPLANATION and PRICING_STRATEGY_EXPLANATION record why a segment or strategy applied. Imported orders can keep source prices (Freeze Price on Sales Orders). How charges and freight reach Receivables is set in the FulfillmentIntegration service mapping (3.6). |

### 3.3 Order capture

Order Management receives a source order from the UI or from a source system, splits it into order lines and prices it. On submit it runs credit check immediately before approval, routes the order for approval if rules require, and assigns an orchestration process to each line.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Capture and submit sales orders from the Order Management work area, file import, REST or upstream channels (Order Hub pattern). Register each upstream system as a source system and map its values with cross-references, or integrate without cross-referencing customer attributes (Implementing Order Management, Integrate chapter). |
| Typical job roles | Order Entry Specialist, Order Manager, Order Administrator; Supply Chain Integration Specialist for imports. |
| Where in the UI | Order Management work area > New Sales Order page (customer, lines, Submit). Order search and Revert to Draft for changes. View All Actions > Manage Order Orchestration Messages for errors and credit check results (Order Orchestration Function = Credit Verification). AI agents (Implementing Order Management, AI Agents topics; section 10): AI: Sales Order Assistant takes a natural-language request through Ask Oracle on the Order Management home page, ranks matching items and creates a draft order. It is published from the "Sales Order Assistant (Single Agent)" template in AI Agent Studio and needs the ORA_FOM_DEFAULT_BUSINESS_UNIT profile. AI: Purchase Orders to Sales Orders Converter uses Sales Orders > Create Sales Orders from Purchase Orders: upload customer PO PDFs on the redesigned pages. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | DOO_SOURCE_ORDERS (SOURCE_ORDER_ID, SOURCE_ORDER_SYSTEM, SOURCE_REVISION_NUMBER); import interface DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_ALL_INT, DOO_ORDER_LINES_ALL_INT, DOO_ORDER_ADDRESSES_INT (no PK); DOO_HEADERS_ALL (HEADER_ID); DOO_LINES_ALL (LINE_ID); DOO_ORDER_ADDRESSES (ADDRESS_ID); DOO_PAYMENTS (PAYMENT_TRX_ID); DOO_SALES_CREDITS (SALES_CREDIT_ID); DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES (HOLD_INSTANCE_ID); DOO_HOLD_CODES_B (HOLD_CODE_ID); DOO_MESSAGES_B (MESSAGE_ID); DOO_PC_CONSTRAINTS_F (CONSTRAINT_ID); AR_CUST_CREDIT_AUTHORIZATION (CREDIT_AUTHORIZATION_ID); AR_CMGT_CASE_FOLDERS (CASE_FOLDER_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | DOO_HEADERS_ALL.STATUS_CODE: Draft, Approval Pending, Processing, Open, Partial, Closed, Canceled, Reference; Credit Review Pending when credit check fails with the Save Order in Draft Status option. SUBMITTED_FLAG (N not submitted, Y validated and submitted), OPEN_FLAG, ON_HOLD, CANCELED_FLAG, SOURCE_ORDER_SYSTEM, CREATION_MODE (capture interface), AGENT_CODE (AI agent that created the order). DOO_HOLD_INSTANCES.ACTIVE_FLAG, APPLY_DATE, RELEASE_DATE, HOLD_RELEASE_REASON_CODE. |
| REST root resources | `salesOrdersForOrderHub` (GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE; actions `applyHold`, `releaseHold`, `splitFulfillmentLine`, `updateActualDeliveryDate`, `updateSchedulingAttribute`), `salesOrdersForOrderHubRequests`, `salesOrderActionRequests`; Global Order Promising for availability (`/fscmRestApi/msp/latest/globalOrderPromises/checkAvailability`; it replaces the deprecated Order Promises resource, 6.3); Customer for Sales Orders (`createCustomer`, see 3.1). Examples: `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/salesOrdersForOrderHub` and `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/salesOrdersForOrderHub/action/applyHold`. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | FBDI Import Sales Orders (SourceSalesOrderImportTemplate.xlsm; 17 interface tables such as DOO_ORDER_HEADERS_ALL_INT and DOO_ORDER_LINES_ALL_INT) processed by Import Sales Orders. Delete Orders from Interface Tables; Recover Errors; Submit Actions for Orders or Order Lines; Adjust Amounts for Credit Authorizations. |
| Key controls and exceptions | The customer must exist before import. Import Sales Orders is case-sensitive; the template uses Y/N and REST uses true/false. REST is synchronous: multi-order payloads that run more than about 5 minutes can time out, so send one source order per payload or use FBDI. Credit check (parameter Activate Credit Check on Order Submit) runs at submit and immediately before approval, and reruns when an attribute that affects payment, such as Bill-To Customer, changes or a revision is submitted. Credit Check Failure at Order Submit decides the result: Save Order in Draft Status gives Credit Review Pending (no line holds), and Submit the Order with Hold on Lines That Failed Credit Check sets the order to Processing, holds the failed lines and sends the other lines to fulfillment. A failed revision always goes to Credit Review Pending. An order in Credit Review Pending can't be changed: use Revert to Draft, edit, resubmit. You can't apply a credit check hold manually; users with the privilege can release one. Lines on credit check hold can be queried or canceled but not revised; Bill-to Customer, Ordered Quantity, Ordered UOM, Transaction Currency Code and Extended Amount are locked. Credit hold on the customer credit profile puts existing orders on hold, and AutoInvoice can't import that customer's Order Management invoices (manual transactions still work). Processing constraints block changes by status and role. Agent actions are audited in DOO_AGENT_ACTION_HISTORY (AGENT_EXECUTION_MODE such as HUMAN_ASSIST or AUTO). |

### 3.4 Orchestration and fulfillment

The predefined ShipOrderGenericProcess runs these steps in sequence (task service in brackets): 100 Schedule (Create Scheduling), 200 Create Reservation (Create Inventory Reservation), 300 Create Shipment Request (Create Shipping), 400 Wait for Shipment Advice (Wait for Shipment), 500 Create Invoice (Create Billing Lines), 600 Wait for Invoice (Wait for Billing). A hold stops the process before the next task; holds applied while Order Management compensates a change are released automatically when compensation finishes.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Turn order lines into fulfillment lines and run the assigned orchestration process: schedule with Global Order Promising, reserve, ship, bill. Split lines when partially shipped or sourced. Create supply through Supply Chain Orchestration for drop ship and back-to-back lines. |
| Typical job roles | Order Manager; Order Administrator (orchestration setup); Supply Chain Operations Manager; Order Orchestration Error Recovery Manager (abstract role); Warehouse Manager (reservations). |
| Where in the UI | Order Management work area: order lines and fulfillment views, Manage Order Orchestration Messages, jeopardy. Setup and Maintenance: orchestration process definition, deployment and assignment tasks (Implementing Order Management, Orchestrate chapter). |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL (FULFILL_LINE_ID); DOO_FULFILL_LINE_DETAILS (FULFILL_LINE_DETAIL_ID); DOO_PROCESS_DEFINITIONS_B (DOO_PROCESS_ID); DOO_PROCESS_INSTANCES (DOO_PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID); DOO_PROCESS_STEP_INSTANCES (STEP_INSTANCE_ID); DOO_TASK_INSTANCES (TASK_INSTANCE_ID); DOO_STATUS_RULESETS_B (STATUS_RULESET_ID, ORCHESTRATION_APPLICATION_ID); INV_RESERVATIONS (RESERVATION_ID); DOS_SUPPLY_HEADERS (HEADER_ID); DOS_SUPPLY_LINES (LINE_ID); DOS_SUPPLY_TRACKING_LINES (TRACKING_LINE_ID); FOS_TXN_EVENTS (TRANSACTION_EVENT_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL.STATUS_CODE: Unscheduled, Scheduled, Awaiting Shipping, Shipped, Awaiting Billing, Billed, Closed, Canceled; drop ship moves from Requisition Created to Awaiting Shipping when the purchase order exists. The status rule set applies the true condition with the highest sequence. FULFILLMENT_MODE (Regular, Dropship, Back to Back), SUPPLY_STATUS_CODE, PO_STATUS_CODE, RESERVED_QTY, RESERVATION_ID, SCHEDULE_SHIP_DATE, PROMISE_SHIP_DATE, SPLIT_FROM_FLINE_ID. |
| REST root resources | `salesOrdersForOrderHub` (`splitFulfillmentLine`, `updateSchedulingAttribute`), Global Order Promising (`/fscmRestApi/msp/latest/globalOrderPromises/scheduleSalesOrders`; replaces the deprecated Order Promises resource, 6.3), `inventoryReservations` (action `transferRsvToAnotherDemand`), `inventoryStagedReservations`. Example: `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/inventoryReservations`. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Plan Orchestration Processes; Release Pause Tasks; Process Responses from Order Fulfillment; Recover Errors; Process Supply Chain Orchestration Interface; Close Supply Orders; Manage Reservations Interface (FBDI Inventory Reservation Import, INV_RESERVATIONS_INTERFACE); Submit Financial Orchestration Events; Update Intercompany Receivables Invoice Import Details. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Holds can stop any step; a hold on one line of a shipment set applies to the whole set. Each manual hold needs a release reason; canceling the orchestration process releases its holds. Drop ship: Procurement creates the requisition and purchase order, the supplier ships, receiving creates a logical receipt, Supply Chain Financial Orchestration runs the financial flow, and Cost Management does receipt and cost accounting. Back-to-back: pick release is not processed when the ordered quantity differs from the back-to-back reservation quantity; delete that reservation and create one manually. |

### 3.5 Shipping

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|

| Lifecycle/status columns and values | WSH_DELIVERY_DETAILS.RELEASED_STATUS: ready to release, released to warehouse, staged, shipped, backordered (decode with the SQL in 3.15). INV_INTERFACED_FLAG; SHIPMENT_ADVICE_STATUS (Y sent, N or null not sent); MOVE_ORDER_LINE_ID; BATCH_ID. WSH_NEW_DELIVERIES.STATUS_CODE: Open (OP), Confirmed, Closed; CONFIRM_DATE; ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE. INV_MATERIAL_TXNS.SHIPMENT_COSTED, COGS_RECOGNITION_PERCENT. |

Example: `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/shipmentTransactionRequests/action/shipmentActions`. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Schedule Pick Wave; Pick Release Documents; Confirm Shipments; Create Shipments; Pack Shipments; Close Shipments; Ship Confirm Documents; Send Shipment Advice; Manage Shipment Interface; Perform Shipping Transactions; FBDI Shipment Request Import. Cost: Transfer Transactions from Inventory to Costing; Create Cost Accounting Distributions. SOAP use cases Create Pick Wave Batch and Release Pick Wave Batch (section 7). |
| Key controls and exceptions | Ship confirm needs a ship confirm rule or options, resolved error exceptions, and recorded lot and serial numbers. Order Management moves the line to Shipped only after the shipment is interfaced to inventory and closed. A confirmed shipment can be reopened; a closed shipment cannot. The actual ship date is later than the pick transaction date of all lines. Ship-only orders recognize COGS at 100% at issue; ship-and-bill orders defer COGS until revenue is recognized (3.7). |

### 3.6 Billing

Order Management's Create Invoice step sends billing lines to the AutoInvoice interface. Import AutoInvoice creates the transactions, then runs Notify Feeder System of Receivables Transactions so Order Management can move the line from Awaiting Billing to Billed. Section 3.14 shows which interface columns Order Management fills.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Create invoices and credit memos from Order Management, other feeders (FBDI, REST) or manual entry. Calculate tax and installments, then present the bill by print, email, XML or Bill Management. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Receivable Specialist, Accounts Receivable Manager; Billing Specialist Segregated Role and Billing Manager Segregated Role where billing is segregated; Order Manager for billing errors on orders. |
| Where in the UI | Billing work area: create and manage transactions (update, duplicate, credit, adjust, dispute, preview); review incomplete transactions; review and correct AutoInvoice errors, or download the Manage AutoInvoice Lines spreadsheet. Bill Management: external customer portal. |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL (no PK; INTERFACE_LINE_ID); RA_INTERFACE_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL; RA_INTERFACE_SALESCREDITS_ALL; AR_INTERFACE_CONTS_ALL; RA_INTERFACE_ERRORS_ALL; RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL (CUSTOMER_TRX_ID); RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL (CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID); RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ALL (CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ID); RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_SALESREPS_ALL; AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL (PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID); ZX_LINES (TAX_LINE_ID); RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL (CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID); RA_BATCH_SOURCES_ALL (BATCH_SOURCE_SEQ_ID); RA_TERMS_B (TERM_ID); ARB_REG_USER_PROFILES (REG_USER_PROFILE_ID); ARB_PAYMENT_AUDIT (PAYMENT_AUDIT_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL.INTERFACE_STATUS ("Oracle internal use only" in the 26D comment; do not build logic on its values), REQUEST_ID; rows with errors in RA_INTERFACE_ERRORS_ALL. RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL.COMPLETE_FLAG (Y/N); DOCUMENT_STATUS_CODE (lookup ORA_AR_TRX_DOCUMENT_STATUS); CONTROL_COMPLETION_REASON_CODE (NEGATIVE_LINE_AMT_NOT_ALLOWED, NO_TRX_ALLOWED_TO_COMPLETE, ALLOWED_TO_COMPLETE). RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL.TYPE (INV, CM, DM, CB). DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL.INVOICE_INTERFACED_FLAG and INVOICE_INTERFACE_STATUS. |
| REST root resources | `receivablesInvoices` (actions `approve`, `rework`, `resendInvoiceCopy`, `splitInstallments`), `autoInvoiceInterfaceLines` (GET, PATCH), `transactionSourcesLOV`, `transactionTypesLOV`, `paymentTermsLOV`, `memoLinesLOV`, `billManagementUsers`. Examples: `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/receivablesInvoices` and `GET /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/autoInvoiceInterfaceLines`. |

Notify Feeder System of Receivables Transactions; Purge AutoInvoice Interface Data (runs automatically when the Purge interface tables system option is on); Print Receivables Transactions; Create Customer Statements. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Rejected lines stay in the interface with errors in RA_INTERFACE_ERRORS_ALL and the AutoInvoice Execution Report. Unprocessed lines from Oracle Fusion upstream systems (Order Management, Project Management, Subscriptions) can be corrected in the Manage AutoInvoice Lines workbook only with the Update AutoInvoice Interface Lines privilege, and they can't be purged. Order Management, not Receivables, defaults the transaction type: Invoice for fulfilled lines (an extension can change it) and Credit Memo for return lines (do not change). Other controls: Control of Transaction Completion, grouping rules, document sequencing. Under transaction approval, completed transactions get Pending Approval and approvers act in the Transaction Approval infotile of the Billing work area or through the `approve` and `rework` actions; by default an initiator can't approve their own transaction and uses Withdraw to correct it. Charge lines carry LineType LINE, FREIGHT, CHARGES or TAX. To recognize freight as revenue, map the shipping charge to LineType LINE in the FulfillmentIntegration service mapping. Bill Management external users get the role chosen in Manage Bill Management System Options (for example Customer Accounts Payable Specialist). |

### 3.7 Revenue recognition

Use Receivables revenue scheduling when revenue follows the invoice line. Use Revenue Management (ASC 606 and IFRS 15) when you need contract identification, standalone selling price allocation and satisfaction-based recognition across orders, invoices and other sources. Revenue Management takes over for orders when the source document type DOO Sales Order has an Extraction Start Date (the first extract can include orders up to 90 days old), and for invoices when a Receivables transaction source is enabled, with a start date, on the System Options page in Revenue Management. For COGS alignment, also define the Revenue Management costing-integration lookup code under lookup type ORA_AR_FEATURES on the Manage Receivables Lookups page (code given in the 26D topic on integrating Revenue Management with Order Management).

| Item | Receivables revenue scheduling | Revenue Management |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose | Spread or defer invoice revenue with revenue scheduling rules, invoicing rules (In Advance, In Arrears), revenue policies and contingencies | Group source lines into customer contracts and performance obligations, allocate by standalone selling price, recognize on satisfaction events or satisfaction plans |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Receivable Manager, Accounts Receivable Specialist | Revenue Analyst, Revenue Manager |
| Where in the UI | Revenue Management work area of Receivables: Recognize Revenue, revenue adjustments, contingencies, sales credit transfers | Revenue Management Overview page: tabs Pending Review, Pending Allocation, Pending Revenue Recognition; open a contract link, then the Promised Details tab (obligations, promised details, satisfaction events, history); Correct Contract Document Errors in Spreadsheet panel tab |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | RA_CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ALL (CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ID); RA_RULES (RULE_ID); AR_REVENUE_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL (REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_ID); AR_LINE_CONTS_ALL (CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID, CONTINGENCY_CODE); AR_DEFERRED_LINES_ALL (CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID) | VRM_SOURCE_DOCUMENTS (DOCUMENT_ID); VRM_SOURCE_DOC_LINES (DOCUMENT_LINE_ID); VRM_SOURCE_DOC_SUB_LINES (DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID); VRM_CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADERS (CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID); VRM_PERF_OBLIGATIONS (PERF_OBLIGATION_ID); VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_LINES (PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID); VRM_POL_SATISFACTION_EVENTS (POL_SATISFACTION_EVENT_ID); VRM_BILLING_LINE_DETAILS (BILLING_LINE_DETAIL_ID); VRM_ACCOUNTING_EVENTS (ACCOUNTING_EVENT_ID) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | ACCOUNT_CLASS (Revenue, Unearned Revenue, Unbilled Receivable, Receivable and others); ACCOUNT_SET_FLAG (Y = account set, not yet scheduled); AR_LINE_CONTS_ALL rows hold open contingencies | Contract REVIEW_STATUS, ALLOCATION_STATUS, SATISFACTION_STATUS; obligation SATISFACTION_METHOD and SATISFACTION_STATUS; line LINE_SATISFACTION_STATUS (Not started, Extent satisfied, Fully satisfied; lookup ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTN_STATUS); MISSING_REV_INFORMATION_FLAG |
| REST root resources | `receivablesInvoices` (distributions child), `revenueSchedulingRulesLOV` | `revenueContracts` (GET: obligations, promised details, satisfaction events, source documents), `sourceDocumentLines` (GET, PATCH) |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Recognize Revenue (writes the Revenue Recognition Execution report) | Extract Sales Orders for Revenue Management (Order Management); Extract Revenue Basis Data from Oracle Fusion Applications (Receivables source); FBDI Revenue Basis Data Import via Load Interface File for Import and Import Revenue Basis Data; Validate Customer Contract Source Data; Identify Customer Contracts; Import Billing Data from Oracle Fusion Receivables (FBDI Billing Data Import for billing from other applications, verify in your pod); Recognize Revenue; Create Accounting |
| Key controls and exceptions | Recognize Revenue creates distributions in periods with status Open, Future or Not Open; amounts for Closed or Close Pending periods go to the next such period. Reclassifying a distribution creates reversing entries automatically. COGS: run Import Revenue Lines, then Create Cost Accounting Distributions with the Cost of Goods Sold processor. | The Receivables invoice books Dr Receivables, Cr Revenue Clearing. Revenue Management books Dr Contract Asset, Cr Contract Liability (initial performance event); Dr Contract Liability, Cr Contract Revenue (satisfaction); Dr Contract Clearing (called Revenue Clearing in the Order Management integration topic), Cr Contract Asset and Contract Discount (billing, from Import Billing Data). Fix source errors in the Correct Contract Document Errors spreadsheet and upload it. COGS: Revenue Management Create Accounting passes revenue events to Cost Management, so Import Revenue Lines is not needed; run Create Cost Accounting Distributions with the Cost of Goods Sold processor option. |

The 26D comment on AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL.TYPE advises filtering with = 'MISC' or != 'MISC' rather than = 'CASH'. |

Example: `POST /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/standardReceipts/{StandardReceiptId}/action/applyReceipt`. |

Apply Receipts Using AutoMatch; Clear Receipts Automatically; Create Automatic Receipt Write-offs; Create Automatic Remittances (also remits the negative miscellaneous receipt of a credit card refund). |
| Key controls and exceptions | AutoApply (lockbox or system option) applies exact matches and returns recommendations scored by the AutoMatch rule set. Application exception rule sets handle over- and underpayments. Refunds need an unapplied amount on a remitted or cleared receipt, and can't exceed the original receipt amount or the remaining unapplied amount. Non-card refunds (receipts or on-account credit memos) send a refund request to Payables, which sends a payment request to Payments. Card refunds create a negative miscellaneous receipt that Create Automatic Remittances sends directly to Payments. Write-offs are limited by receipt write-off approval limits. Receipt class remittance and clearance methods decide the lifecycle states (3.12). |

| REST root resources | `cashBankAccounts`, `cashExternalTransactions`, `cashBanks`, `cashBankBranches`. The 26D catalog has no bank statement REST resource; load statements by file. |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Load and Import Bank Statement (formats BAI2, SWIFT MT940, EDIFACT FINSTA, ISO20022 CAMT052 and CAMT053); Schedule Process Electronic Bank Statement Request; Autoreconciliation; Create Bank Statement Transactions; FBDI Cash Management Bank Statement Data Import, Cash Management Bank Statement Reconciliation Data Import, Cash Management External Transactions Import. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Assign a matching rule set (matching plus tolerance rules, in priority order) to each bank account. Clearance method by receipt class: Directly (no further processing), By Automatic Clearing (Clear Receipts Automatically or Cash Management), By Matching (cleared in Cash Management). Review with the Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation Report. |

### 3.13 Period close for O2C

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Finish billing and cash, recognize revenue and COGS, account everything, reconcile Receivables to GL, age and revalue open items, then close Receivables, Cost Management and GL periods in that order. |
| Typical job roles | Accounts Receivable Manager, Revenue Manager, Cost Accountant, Cash Manager, General Accounting Manager. |
| Where in the UI | Receivables Balances work area (receivables accounting period statuses, Receivables to GL reconciliation); Revenue Management; cost accounting periods; General Ledger period close (section 4). |
| Key tables (TABLE (PK)) | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES (APPLICATION_ID, LEDGER_ID, PERIOD_NAME); AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL (open items and aging); RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL (unprocessed billing); XLA_EVENTS and XLA_AE_HEADERS (unaccounted or untransferred events); VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_LINES (unsatisfied obligations) |
| Lifecycle/status columns and values | GL_PERIOD_STATUSES.CLOSING_STATUS: O Open, F Future Enterable, C Closed, P Permanently Closed, N Never Opened (codes are the same as sections 2 and 4 but are not listed in the 26D column comment). Receivables and Revenue Management also use W Close Pending (value documented on the `accountingPeriodStatusLOV` REST resource, 11.2.1). |
| REST root resources | `accountingPeriodStatusLOV`, `accountingPeriodsLOV`, `journalBatches`, `erpintegrations` (extracts) |
| FBDI / scheduled processes | Prepare Receivables to General Ledger Reconciliation, then Receivables to General Ledger Reconciliation Report; Subledger Period Close Exception Report; Potential Reconciling Items Report; Receivables Aging by General Ledger Account Report; Receivables Open Items Revaluation Report; Revenue Contract Account Activity Report; Open Performance Obligation Report; Contract Residual Account Balance Write-Off Report; Validate and Update Cost Accounting Periods; Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation Report. |
| Key controls and exceptions | Close order: Receivables, then Cost Management, then GL (combined P2P and O2C sequence in 4.9). The 26D Cost Management COGS topic recommends this order to avoid date mismatches. To find blockers, set the period to Close Pending and run the Subledger Period Close Exception Report. Pending Approval and invalid transactions block a Close Pending period; move them with Sweep Subledger Transactions to Another Period. Enter a unique Request Name for each Prepare Receivables to General Ledger Reconciliation run. Manual GL journals to receivable accounts and untransferred subledger journals are common reconciling items (Potential Reconciling Items Report). |
